title: Platform Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Vollzeit 40 h · 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder hybrid an Standorten bundesweit Security-Konzeption mit eigener Umsetzung in AWS und Kubernetes verbinden Für den SaaS-Provider einer der großen deutschen IT- und Software-Gruppen (über 10.000 Mitarbeitende weltweit) suche ich das Security-Gewissen einer cloudbasierten Betriebsplattform: Auf ihr laufen die Softwareprodukte der Gruppe – vor allem für Banken und Versicherungen – im regulierten Betrieb (DORA, ISO), vollständig software-defined auf AWS und Kubernetes. Du wirst die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle Security-Themen des Plattform-Teams: Du steuerst, bewertest, priorisierst – und setzt selbst mit um. Ganz ehrlich: Die Rolle ist bewusst breit, etwa halb konzeptionell, halb hands-on – genau das macht sie zur Gestaltungsrolle statt zum Spezialisten-Silo. Deine Aufgaben Security-Konzeption: Du konzipierst und entwickelst die Security-Konzepte der Plattform weiter und integrierst Security-Prinzipien in Architektur, Infrastruktur und Prozesse. Vulnerability & CVE Management: Du analysierst, bewertest und verfolgst Schwachstellen, leitest Mitigierungsstrategien ab und operationalisierst das Schwachstellenmanagement. Monitoring & Detection: Du gestaltest Security Monitoring und Detection Engineering mit – von Cloud/Kubernetes Security Posture Management bis zur SOC-Schnittstelle. Steuerung & Audits: Du priorisierst den Security-Backlog mit der Abteilungsleitung, steuerst Lieferanten und unterstützt bei Audits (u. a. DORA, ISO). Dein Profil Cloud Security: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud Security oder Platform Engineering mit – Schwerpunkt der letzten Jahre in AWS oder Azure, nicht On-Prem. Engineering-Mindset: Du verstehst Kubernetes-Security und arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Git, Infrastructure as Code (u. a. Terraform) und Pipelines – Automation first. Ende-zu-Ende: Du hast Security-Themen schon von der Konzeption bis in den produktiven Betrieb geführt – du bist weder reiner Analyst noch reine Operations-Rolle. Kommunikation: Du reportest Themen klar – im Team, mit der Führung, im Ausnahmefall mit dem CISO eines Kunden. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut. Das erwartet dich Gestaltungsfreiheit: Security als Gesamtverantwortung statt Teilausschnitt – mit echtem Mandat und der Perspektive, ein eigenes SOC mit aufzubauen. Flexibilität: 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder hybrid, Gleitzeit ohne Kernarbeitszeit, 32–40 Stunden – dein Setup, deine Zeitsouveränität. Stabilität: Teil einer seit über vier Jahrzehnten gewachsenen, unabhängigen Unternehmensgruppe – mit Start-up-artigem Team-Setup, aber ohne Start-up-Risiko. Konditionen & Benefits: Faires Vergütungspaket, Firmenwagen inkl. Tank-/Ladekarte (alt. Jobrad), 30 Tage Urlaub plus Sabbatical-Option, Udemy Professional und 10 % Weiterbildungszeit. title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance (Vulnerable Customers)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐<br><br></strong>Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service. We're looking for someone with experience specifically in the Vulnerable Customer domain.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-CB4</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: (Senior) Product Manager:in KYC (m/w/d)
description: Du willst nicht Tickets verwalten, sondern herausfinden, welches Problem sich zu lösen lohnt? Regulatorik ist für dich keine Textwüste, sondern die Landkarte, auf der du Produktchancen findest? Dann komm in unser Produktteam! Du übernimmst im Tandem die Hauptverantwortung für KYCnow – die Plattform, mit der über 400 Banken, Versicherungen und Unternehmen ihre KYC- und KYB-Prüfungen automatisieren. Deine Aufgaben im Produktmanagement Discovery: Du führst Kunden- und Nutzerinterviews, validierst Probleme und testest Lösungsideen früh mit Prototypen Markt und Wettbewerb: Du beobachtest Wettbewerber und regulatorische Entwicklungen wie die AMLR und leitest daraus Chancen ab Providersteuerung: Du steuerst unsere Datenprovider und Fernident-Anbieter – fachlich wie kommerziell, von der Datenqualität bis zum Vertrag Produktstrategie: Im Tandem übersetzt du die Unternehmensstrategie in Produktstrategie, Roadmap und klare Ziele Impulse bewerten: Ideen aus Markt, Kundschaft, Sales und Regulatorik bewertest du nach Kundennutzen und Marktchance – und sagst auch fundiert Nein Wirkung messen: Du definierst Produktmetriken und prüfst nach dem Release, ob der erwartete Nutzen eintritt Zusammenarbeit: Mit Entwicklung, Design, Recht, KYC Operations, Sales und Support findest du im agilen Setup gemeinsame Lösungen – regulatorische Fragen klärst du früh und direkt Das solltest du mitbringen Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement digitaler B2B-Produkte bzw. SaaS-Produkte, inklusive Verantwortung für Ergebnisse – nicht nur für Backlogs. Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten – du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl Berufserfahrung im KYC-, AML- oder RegTech-Umfeld gewünscht Routine in Discovery-Methoden: Interviews, Hypothesen, Prototyping, Beta-Tests Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools in der täglichen Produktarbeit; ein Gespür für KI als sinnvollen Produktbestandteil ist ein Plus Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner samt Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen von Vorteil Präsentationsstärke gegenüber Kundschaft, Management und Fachbereichen Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch Das bieten wir dir Geteilte Hauptverantwortung für KYCnow – mit Gestaltungsspielraum von Tag eins Priorisierung nach Kundennutzen und Marktchancen statt nach interner Aufwandsverrechnung Führung durch Kontext statt durch Hierarchie – kollaborativ und transparent über alle Bereiche hinweg Impact: Mit deiner Arbeit hilfst du uns, Geldwäsche schwieriger zu machen. Ein engagiertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, offenen Türen und einem wertschätzenden Umgang miteinander – und mit Spaß an der Arbeit. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket und Bike Leasing Flexible Arbeitszeiten, remote deutschlandweit oder hybrid an den Standorten Frankfurt und Kassel Über uns Wir sind KYCnow, ein RegTech-Unternehmen mit klarem Auftrag: Wir machen KYC einfach, damit Geldwäsche schwierig wird. Unsere Plattform unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen und Finanzdienstleister dabei, ihre Pflichten nach dem GwG effizient, automatisiert und revisionssicher zu erfüllen: von Stammdaten und UBO-Ermittlung bis hin zu Screening, Monitoring und Regular Reviews. Wir sind ein diverses Team aus Expert:innen für Technologie, Compliance, Design und Kommunikation und arbeiten daran, komplexe Regulierung in nutzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen - für Verpflichtete, die Verantwortung tragen und Prozesse smarter machen wollen. title: Sales Development - UK/I
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role Our Sales Development team play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion. Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results Requirements 2–3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of securing net-new business meetings Proven ability to build and qualify opportunity-sized lead lists in new markets and verticals Fluency with modern prospecting tools and multi-channel outreach strategies Experience building and scaling outbound processes in fast-paced environments Intellectually curious, asking thoughtful questions and developing insights-driven approaches to outreach Highly self-motivated, able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team culture Strong prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to handle a high volume of leads efficiently Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English Fluency in additional European languages is desirable but not essential Location This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in London or Dublin with the option to work out of one of our offices. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Lead Growth Analyst
description: Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world. We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles. The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you? We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. Our aim is to help the business understand what is driving growth, where performance is changing, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are. In this role, you will lead analysis on some of our most important growth questions. You will take ownership of analytical workstreams end to end, from framing the business question and exploring the data through to clear recommendations and supporting execution. A key part of the role will be helping teams make better growth and investment decisions. You will bring together signals from channel performance, customer behaviour and experimentation to understand what is driving performance. You will partner closely with Growth, Marketing and Product teams, acting as a trusted thought partner. Key responsibilities Drive end-to-end analysis on priority growth questions, from problem definition through to recommendation and measurement. Proactively identify and investigate changes in growth performance, including the key drivers, risks and opportunities behind them, rather than waiting for questions to be handed over. Identify and size growth opportunities across channels, customer journeys and Product. Support investment decisions by bringing together MMM, channel performance and customer behaviour. Build clear growth narratives from complex analysis, translating data into concise, understandable insights with a strong “so what”, and clearly articulating the implications and actions for stakeholders. Contribute to wider commercial questions such as forecasting, pricing and scenario analysis where they materially affect growth. Build scalable analytical approaches that improve the speed, consistency and quality of decision-making. Act as a trusted analytical partner, bringing a clear analytical point of view that shapes key growth decisions. Own key stakeholder relationships and help ensure analytical recommendations are followed through into action and measurable impact. Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team. Experience and competencies Significant experience in growth, marketing, or commercial analytics within a digital, marketplace, subscription or consumer technology business. Strong understanding of growth, customer acquisition, funnel performance and the interaction between Marketing and Product. Experience analysing customer journeys across multiple stages of the funnel, including cohort behaviour, lifecycle performance and longer conversion or nurturing journeys. Good knowledge of marketing effectiveness approaches such as MMM, incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution. Proven ability to independently structure and lead complex or ambiguous analytical work. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move from analysis to clear recommendations. Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, influencing without authority and partnering closely with leadership teams. Flexible and open-minded, able to thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment. Clear, confident communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills. Tools and technical skills Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns Familiarity with analytical tools and languages such as Python or R. Experience working with marketing and experimentation data from major digital platforms and internal data warehouses (we use Databricks). Practical understanding of advanced measurement methodologies and their limitations in real-world decision-making. Nice to have: experience integrating AI tools into analytical workflows in a way that's actually made a difference Compensation Additional Information In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including: 🐾 For the love of pets Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per year towards travel costs to and from sits Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home 💜 Health & wellbeing SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan Specsavers eyecare scheme Weekly virtual yoga sessions Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance 💻 Working environment Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule 💰 Compensation & time off 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles) Competitive salary which is reviewed annually Generous equity package for permanent employees Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters £500 recruitment referral bonus If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you! In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability. Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

title: Sr. Security Engineer (Penetration Testing)
description: Why Us? CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, leveraging best-in-class AI technology to protect and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. Founded in 2018 by professors from Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK’s mission is to secure the web3 world. CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia to enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to scale with safety and correctness. About the Role The primary responsibility of this role is for CertiK’s security-related services. Intersecting cybersecurity and blockchain, CertiK’s security offerings include security consulting, security reviews, security auditing of smart contracts and blockchains, verification of smart contracts, penetration testing, and more. We are looking to hire someone with a passion for application security and penetration testing. This is a fun and challenging full-time position. If you are excited about hacking, threat modeling, scanning, auditing, designing, and enhancing the security of applications across the board then you will thrive in this role. While you work with clients, we will also provide you with plenty of opportunities to get involved with research and development efforts to help us raise the standards of blockchain security. Responsibilities Perform security assessments on web, mobile, thick client applications, and browser extensions Conduct external and internal network penetration tests Perform security source code reviews Perform cloud security reviews Develop comprehensive pentest reports for both technical and non-technical audiences Research and develop innovative techniques, tools, and methodologies for pentesting applications in the blockchain space Contribute to the community by developing tools, presentations, and blog posts Requirements Passionate about cryptocurrency, DeFi, and blockchain, with a willingness to learn Web3 technologies such as smart contracts Minimum of 4 years of experience in application security and penetration testing Experienced in source code review for different languages, with a strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript Experienced in mobile application penetration testing Familiar with cloud platforms and their security risks, such as AWS, Azure, and GCP Experience in programming with scripting languages such as Python and Bash Solid understanding of cryptography BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or Information Security Strong spoken and written communication skills Bonus Points Experienced in pentesting Web3 applications such as crypto exchanges, wallets, Dapps, and key custodian solutions Experienced in smart contract security audits Familiar with browser extension architecture and security risks Actively participate in the blockchain security community OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, GWAPT, or comparable certification Participated in bug bounty programs and audit contests Published security-related blog posts and spoken at security conferences and/or local meetups Compensation Additional Information About the Company One of the fastest-growing and most trusted companies in blockchain security, CertiK is a true market leader. To date, CertiK has worked with over 3,200 Enterprise clients, secured over $310 billion worth of digital assets, and has detected over 60,000 vulnerabilities in blockchain code. Our clients include leading projects such as Aave, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Terra, Yearn, and Chiliz. Investors = Insight Partners, Sequoia, Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Lightspeed, Advent International, SoftBank, Hillhouse Capital, Goldman Sachs, Coinbase Ventures, Binance, Shunwei Capital, IDG Capital, Wing, Legend Star, Danhua Capital and other investors. Compensation Target annual base salary for this role performed in the US is $100,000 - $180,000. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates. #LI-Remote #blockchain #startups #hiring CertiK is proud to offer medical, vision, and dental insurance, 401(k) plan with company matching, life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, HSA (with high deductible plan), FSA, and other benefits to all full-time employees, along with flexible paid time off and holidays. CertiK also offers a variable commission program for business development sales roles. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. CertiK is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of age, race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, medical condition, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status or civil partnership/union status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, genetic information, military and veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state or local law. CertiK will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/migrated_files/employers/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf All CertiK employees are expected to actively support diversity on their teams, and in the Company.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Products
description: ABOUT THE TEAM When the world's largest organizations bet on Mural, Govern & Trust is the team that earns that trust at scale. We build the experiences that help enterprises roll out Mural with confidence, keep it secure, and see the impact it has on how their people work. Data sits at the center of it all. Admins are Mural's most demanding data consumers: they need to prove ROI to their leadership, guide adoption across thousands of people, and account for every action. If data products can meet their bar, they'll work for everyone. Mural has a modern data platform, strong data engineering and analytics teams, and a wealth of data on how teams collaborate. The next step is treating that data as a product in its own right, with a dedicated owner for what it means and how it's used. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Product Manager you'll define the metrics that describe how Mural creates value, and make them the shared foundation for everything built on top. The same definitions will power internal product decisions, the Insights experience Admins use in the product, and the reporting API and MCP server that customers and AI agents query. This role starts upstream. You'll work from raw product events to decide what each metric should measure, how it's calculated, and what the data needs to look like for customers and internal teams to rely on it. Then you'll turn those metrics into experiences that help organizations understand and grow their use of Mural. WHAT YOU'LL DO The evolution of data products. Shape how Mural's data products move from reporting on what happened to guiding what happens next. Work across the Govern & Trust portfolio to define how insights become part of how organizations run Mural. The metric layer. Define Mural's shared, cross-product metrics, like activity, collaboration, and adoption. Set the standards that let product teams define and publish their own metrics consistently. Data Engineering builds and runs the layer; you shape what goes in it and how it evolves. Internal product analytics. Be a thought partner to domain PMs as they set their north-star metrics, and make product data easy for them to explore on their own. Work with Business Analytics to keep product-facing and business-facing reporting working together. Customer-facing data products. Own the strategy and roadmap for Insights: in-product reporting and dashboards, exports and APIs, audit logs, and the methodology behind every number customers see. AI and agent access. Package and launch Mural's customer-facing reporting MCP server: which data it exposes, which plans get it, and what guardrails apply. Define how natural-language and agent-driven analysis extends Insights. Instrumentation. R&D teams own emitting events. Your job is to raise the bar on what they emit. Set per-product requirements for granularity and retention, which differ for audit logs, activity data, and product analytics. Partner with Data Engineering on event standards so metrics start from good data. WHAT YOU'LL BRING 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one analytics or reporting product used by paying business customers. You defined the metrics behind it, not just the UI. A track record of making messy or conflicting data trustworthy: reconciling competing definitions, writing metric specs engineers could build from, and getting instrumentation changed upstream. Experience building both platform products, where your customers are internal teams or developers, and end-user-facing data products like analytics, reporting, or insights. You understand how the two have to work together. Working knowledge of modern data stacks: event pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses, dbt-style modeling, and semantic layers. You can write SQL and pull data yourself. The ability to get agreement on definitions across teams you don't manage, including PMs, data engineering, analytics, finance, and go-to-market. Experience with enterprise admin or governance products (IAM, security, compliance, audit) Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML) Experience designing APIs, MCP servers, or connectors for analytics Equal Opportunity We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
description: Position: Account Specialist The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German. The Role: As an Account Specialist , you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives. The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Top 5 Responsibilities: INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING – Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes. INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives. AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients. CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION - Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating. PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT - Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve. What Success Looks Like: BY 3 MONTHS: The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place. You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation. You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured. By 6 MONTHS: You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications. Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively. You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns. Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns. You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance By 1 YEAR: You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams. You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies. You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own Works independently with minimal supervision Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners Qualifications & Skills: Fluency in German 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience Ability to travel up to 15% Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching Open Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday company-wide shut-down weeks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! title: Channel Account Manager

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. Foster collaborative relationships with partners through ongoing engagement, communication, and business reviews. Support the execution of marketing and demand generation activities with partners to drive brand awareness and lead generation. Support the promotion and engagement with the Ping Partner program and related tools and processes. Assist in coordinating and participating in joint business planning activities with partners. Assist in ensuring partner success by monitoring delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and support. Contribute to joint pursuits with partners, identifying and developing sales opportunities and impacting existing opportunities to close with the influence of Partners. Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities and challenges Required Skills & Qualifications: This role is based in Sydney or Melbourne. Alternatively, you have excelled in a Partner BDR/SDR function and are looking to move up in your career. You have a good understanding of the Australia and New Zealand market. You are currently working in the SaaS industry, but working in Cyber Security and SaaSwill move you right to the top of the list. Understanding of channel sales strategies and partner ecosystems. Ability to drive mutual business outcomes for both Ping and our Partners - this includes regular cadence, partner QBRs etc. Good CRM opportunity hygiene (Salesforce preferred). Strong organisational and coordination skills and the ability to work cross functionally with presales, marketing, professional services, customer success etc. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Willingness to learn and adapt to changing priorities and responsibilities. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to travel domestically as required and 1-2 international trips per year (US). …and have fun and enjoy the ride working in a very high growth dynamic environment for a great company headquartered in Denver Colorado Other: Familiarity with Salesforce.com or other CRM systems. Previous experience or exposure to channel sales, alliances management, or partner enablement is a must. Interest in the software industry and identity access management sector. Knowledge of marketing and demand generation practices. Understanding of partner training and sales enablement processes. Ability to analyse data and generate insights to drive partner performance. Proactive and positive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement. Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. Global volunteering and community initiatives Our Benefits: Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule Parental Leave Progressive Healthcare Options Retirement Programs Opportunity for Education Reimbursement Commuter Offset (Specific locations) Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Business Value Engineer | UK | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: Grafana Labs is seeking to grow our Business Value Engineer team and support defining, articulating, and quantifying business value across our products and services. As a member of the business value engineering team, you'll play a critical role in shaping the direction of this high-impact function. What You’ll Be Doing: Customer Insights : Collaborate with customers to uncover new opportunities for growth and profitability through personalized storytelling. Value Quantification : Develop compelling ROI/TCO models that identify value areas driven by new products, emerging trends, and market challenges. GTM Enablement : Enable pre/post sales teams through training, content development and support; ensuring our sales organization is equipped to showcase Grafana's value with customers. Value Storytelling : Partner with cross-functional teams to create a unified narrative that showcases Grafana's value proposition, aligning internal stakeholders and external messaging. Strategic Partnerships : Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Observability Architects to define and articulate the business value of our products and services. What Makes you a Great Fit: Innovative Mindset : Possess a growth mindset, willing to learn new technologies and adapt quickly Value Engineering Expertise : 3-5+ years of experience in value management, consulting, or engineering; deep understanding of building quantitative and qualitative analyses. Data Storytelling Skills : Ability to analyze complex data sets, create compelling customer-facing stories, and communicate findings effectively from technical to executive level audiences. Cross-Functional Collaboration : Experience partnering with GTM leaders (Sales, Customer Success, Marketing & Finance) to define and align on Grafana's value propositions. Bonus Points For: 3+ years of Observability experience, preferably with Open Source tools like Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki Familiarity with the Open Source landscape and community If you're ready for a high-impact role that combines data analysis, storytelling, technology enablement, and partnership-building with cross-functional teams – we'd love to hear from you! Compensation & Rewards: In the UK, the OTE compensation range for this role is £130,000 - £155,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
description: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs. What you'll do: Risk Management Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation Compliance and Audit Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners Security Program Support Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up GRC Operations and Tooling Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation What you'll bring: Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years) Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine desire to learn and take on new challenges Hands-on experience with a GRC platform (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) Experience supporting an audit (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar) Exposure to any of: vulnerability management, third-party risk, BC/DR, secure development practices, or penetration test coordination Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, SQL, or workflow tools) to improve GRC processes A relevant certification or one in progress (e.g., Security+, CISA, CISM, CISSP) What you'll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees—we share in our success as one team. Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage. Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute). Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together. Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday. One-time home office stipend. Annual professional development budget. Quarterly well-being stipend. Considerable paid parental leave. Employee referral bonus program. Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc.—varies by country). title: Customer Success Manager
description: Who is Tenable? Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Your Role: The Customer Success Manager (CSM) acts as a trusted advisor for strategic accounts, driving customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction. Building on foundational customer success practices, the CSM takes ownership of complex accounts, proactively addressing adoption challenges and delivering measurable business outcomes. This role uses advanced knowledge of Tenable’s product suite to develop tailored strategies that align customer goals with the right Tenable solutions. The CSM collaborates across internal teams to resolve escalations, guide advanced product adoption, and ensure alignment between customer objectives and business priorities. While this is a remote role, the successful candidate must be based in the Greater Brisbane Area, Queensland, Australia, as the role is focused on local customers and involves regular on-site visits. Your Opportunity: Lead the onboarding process for high-value or complex accounts, ensuring a seamless transition and establishing a strong foundation for success. Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders through regular on-site meetings, acting as a trusted advisor to align customer goals with Tenable solutions. Own and deliver renewal and expansion strategies using a structured sales approach, and use metrics like adoption rates and customer satisfaction scores to monitor success and refine approaches. Proactively monitor customer health metrics to identify risks, mitigate challenges, and implement advanced adoption strategies aligned with customer goals. Use advanced technical knowledge of Tenable’s product suite to design and implement tailored adoption strategies, ensuring alignment with the objectives of high-value or complex accounts. Advocate for customers internally by capturing and communicating feedback to influence product roadmaps, service enhancements, and business priorities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Sales, Professional Services, Engineering, Finance, Training, and Support, to align efforts and deliver impactful customer outcomes. Mentor Associate and Customer Success Managers, providing guidance on best practices, professional growth, and adoption strategies. Contribute to refining customer success frameworks, tools, and processes by providing feedback and actionable insights from the field. What You'll Need: Based in the Greater Brisbane Area, Queensland, Australia, and able to visit customer sites regularly. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, with 8+ years in customer-facing roles, including 5+ years in account management, sales, or similar positions focused on customer retention, growth, and engagement. Proven expertise in managing high-value SaaS or subscription-based accounts, driving adoption and delivering measurable outcomes. Strong relationship management skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and align solutions to business objectives. Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding renewal and expansion targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Deep understanding of Customer Success best practices, including metrics-driven approaches to customer health and adoption. Exceptional communication (written and verbal), problem-solving, and time-management skills. Proficiency in tools such as Salesforce.com and Google Workspace, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly. Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced, revenue-focused environment. Experience mentoring or coaching team members, with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset. Willingness to travel at least 50% of the time, typically a few times per quarter, to support customer engagements or attend business events such as Sales Kickoff or training sessions. #LI-Remote #LI-#LI-KM1 We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact Recruiting@Tenable.com for further assistance. Tenable Data Consent Statement Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you: General Applicant Privacy Notice California Applicant Privacy Notice EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Regional Marketing Manager, ANZ
description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact We're looking for a Campaign Manager to own regional marketing strategy and execution across APAC, turning business priorities and local market opportunities into multi-channel programs that drive awareness, engagement, pipeline, and audience growth. You'll focus on priority markets including Australia, NZ and Thailand, bringing global marketing initiatives to life through locally relevant campaigns, events, webinars, content, and partnerships. You'll also identify opportunities to expand Cloudbeds' reach across Southeast Asia and the wider APAC region, adapting programs to different audiences, market conditions, and business priorities. Reporting to the Sr Manager, Campaign Management, you'll partner with Sales, PMM, Content, Events, Partnerships, Demand Gen, and Marketing Operations to deliver measurable programs that support regional growth. What You Bring to the Team As Campaign Manager, you will: Own regional marketing strategy and execution for APAC, prioritizing programs and investment across key markets to support business goals and regional Sales priorities. Lead local and regional events from planning through execution, including objectives, audiences, budgets, promotion, registration, Sales coordination, onsite execution, follow-up, and measurement. Regionalize and amplify global campaigns, adapting product update webinars, content campaigns, research reports, and product-led initiatives to APAC audiences through the right messaging, channels, timing, and follow-up. Develop market-specific growth programs that build Cloudbeds' awareness and engage local hospitality communities through relevant channels, industry associations, partnerships, and ambassador programs. Contribute to the strategy and planning of global and marquee tradeshows across APAC, defining regional objectives, target audiences, activation, Sales alignment, and follow-up in partnership with the Events team. Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver connected programs, measure performance, and use insights to inform future marketing priorities and investment. What Success Looks Like You're a proactive regional marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You understand that APAC isn't one market and know how to balance global consistency with local relevance, prioritize opportunities across countries, and translate business goals into effective marketing programs. You work closely with Sales without becoming purely reactive, manage multiple programs across time zones, and use performance insights to continuously improve results. You bring: Experience in field marketing, integrated marketing, regional marketing, campaign marketing, or a similar B2B marketing role Hands-on experience managing local and regional events, including budgets, promotion, logistics, onsite execution, and post-event follow-up Experience developing marketing programs across multiple countries or markets, ideally within Asia Pacific and Australia/New Zealand Strong project management, communication, writing, and messaging skills Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales and global marketing teams A performance mindset, with the ability to analyze results and optimize programs and investment Fluency with AI as a daily marketing planning and execution tool, using it to improve quality and scale output without replacing strategic thinking Comfort working in a remote, global environment with distributed teams and stakeholders across time zones Bonus Skills to Stand Out Near-native English fluency (C1 or C2) is required; fluency in Thai is a bonus Experience in hospitality, travel technology, hotel technology, SaaS, or B2B software Experience marketing to hoteliers across Australia, Thailand, Southeast Asia, or other APAC markets Familiarity with regional hospitality communities, industry associations, events, and partner ecosystems Experience with partner marketing, ambassador programs, or regional webinars Experience with Salesforce, Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar marketing automation and CRM systems Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Cloudbeds Awards : Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026) Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026) Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring process.
