title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Germany | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend The Opportunity: Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands. Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities. Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams. Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. Bonus Points For Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems. Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions. Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products. Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations. Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product. Compensation & Rewards: In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 124,571 - EUR 149,485. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

title: General Manager, Industrial Products & Services - US Based
description: Job Summary: As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities. You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan. You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change. You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth. This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes. Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan. Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close. Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business. Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention. Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision. Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting the pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls. Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders. Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team. Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work. Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition. Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business. Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities. In the first month, expect to: Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead. Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities. Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching. Present your proposed IPS business plan, including priority markets and accounts, revenue and profitability assumptions, investment choices, and the first actions you will take. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, account priorities, and ownership. Be personally advancing major pursuits, helping close new business, and building qualified pipelines in priority accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. Have specific expansion plans for key clients and be executing the talent decisions needed to strengthen the team. In the first six months, expect to: Demonstrate measurable commercial progress against the plan through closed new business, expansion revenue, and margin performance. Show that coaching, account planning, and opportunity reviews are improving seller performance and commercial results. Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes. In the first year, expect to: Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives. Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability. Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. 5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required. 12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles. Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected. A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results. Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace. Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability. Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements. Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value. Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders. Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum. Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed. Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off. Compensation Additional Information

title: Senior Software Engineer, Firefox Security
description: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. title: Video Editor at AIOS — Remote, $1,500-$2,000/month (contract)
description: About AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS The opportunity as Video Editor at AIOS We are building a world-class team. As Video Editor at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn sharp creative briefs into scroll-stopping ads, fast, so our best ideas hit the market while they're still fresh. You're an AI-native editor. Tools like Higgsfield are part of your editing suite: you orchestrate AI-generated clips, voiceover, captions and sound into polished direct-response ads, and you only cut by hand where the machine falls short. You work straight from our strategists' briefs: a reference ad, a visual hook direction, a script and the nuances that make it land. You execute precisely, turn concepts around in 24–48 hours and handle revisions the same day. You know what a winning DR ad looks like, from the first three seconds through to the CTA. You'll work across our brands in the UK and US, starting with our UK launch, and across formats: UGC-style, talking head with b-roll, AI-generated video, animation and whatever's working next. You'll: ship multiple finished ad concepts every week spin out hook variations and format iterations on our winning ads build AI editing workflows the rest of the editor pool can use keep quality high at volume: clean captions, synced sound, no visible AI artifacts Great performance in this role means our strategists never wait on production, and every winner gets iterated before it fatigues. This is a full-time, fully remote contract role , and you’ll work async, ideally on US Eastern Time hours so brief handoffs and same-day revisions move fast. You’ll report directly to our Head of Growth, David Charles . You’ll also work most closely with: Jake Antifaev our creative strategists Key Responsibilities Brief to finished ad : You turn strategist briefs into finished direct-response ads, following the reference, hook direction and script precisely. Every brief has nuances that matter, and you catch them. AI production : You generate and assemble AI video assets with tools like Higgsfield, then finish them with captions, music, sound effects and text overlays. Most of your time goes into orchestrating AI, not cutting frame by frame. Iterations on winners : You produce hook variations and format iterations on ads that are already working, so proven concepts keep compounding. Speed : You deliver multiple concepts a week on 24–48 hour turnarounds and turn revisions around the same day. Platform-ready exports : You export in the right aspect ratios and specs for Meta, TikTok and other placements, every time. Quality at volume : Captions are spelled right, music is synced, transitions are clean and AI artifacts are minimised. You check your own work before anyone else has to. Workflow building : You document the prompts, templates and workflows that work, so the editor pool gets faster as it grows. Need to Have Proven DR ad work : You've edited ecommerce or DTC ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok, and you can show them. A general video portfolio isn't enough. AI-native : You use AI video tools (e.g. Higgsfield) every day. You know how to prompt, generate and integrate the outputs into a final edit. DR structure : You understand hook, body and CTA, and you know why the first three seconds matter more than anything else. Animation + multi-format : You've made Pixar-style, cartoon or claymation-style ads that performed, and you're just as strong across other formats: UGC-style, talking head with b-roll and AI-generated video. Fast turnaround : You can deliver a polished concept within 24–48 hours and turn revisions around the same day. Brief execution : You follow detailed briefs precisely without needing to be walked through them. Attention to detail : Captions, sync, transitions and AI artifacts are clean before you hand anything over. Reliable : You hit every deadline without being chased. Clear written English : You communicate clearly and quickly on Slack. ‼️ NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF: you can't show ads you edited that ran on Meta or TikTok, or you'd rather craft slow, polished brand films than ship a high volume of direct-response tests. Nice to Have Cracked AI workflow : You've built an AI editing workflow that lets you ship far more than a traditional editor, and you can walk us through it. Hard-core DR brands : You've edited for DR brands that broke out recently (e.g. Resilia, Bioroot Labs, Elare) and know what's working right now. Trust-building categories : Health, supplements, telehealth or other categories where trust carries the sale. Strategist instincts : You can suggest a sharper hook or a better cut, not just execute the brief. Lead editor potential : You've QA'd or led other editors' work and could step up to lead editor as the pool grows. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. title: Collaborative L&D Specialist
description: Ready to make a real difference in how our people grow? Join our small, collaborative L&D team, where you'll have the autonomy to shape learning that makes a real difference. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website. We are achieving this vision through the following two missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _____________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role As our L&D Specialist, you'll own learning and development projects from end to end. You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand what they actually need (not just what they first ask for), design learning experiences built around how people really learn, pilot solutions, and continuously refine them based on feedback and results. Alongside project work, you'll help keep our learning management system (Thrive) running smoothly, supporting users, managing learning content and using data to understand what's working and where we can improve. You'll also be comfortable using AI as part of your day-to-day work, exploring how it can help us design, develop and deliver high-quality learning faster and smarter without compromising quality. As you develop in the role, you'll have opportunities to facilitate learning sessions and contribute to a wide variety of L&D initiatives across the business. We're a small team with plenty of exciting projects, so you'll gain broad experience, take on increasing responsibility and have lots of opportunities to learn and grow. Team You'll report directly to the L&D Lead as part of a small, hands-on and collaborative L&D team. You'll receive plenty of support as you get up to speed, while being trusted with real ownership from the start. We value people who take initiative, are comfortable navigating ambiguity and enjoy challenging ideas to find better solutions. Like everyone at Laminar, you'll have your own Individual Development Plan, designed to support both your personal and professional growth. Working with your manager and a wider development team, you'll set meaningful goals, build new skills and continue developing throughout your career. It's a core part of how we invest in our people, and something you'll experience yourself, not just help deliver for others. Your top three objectives Design and deliver impactful learning solutions that build capability and help all Lamineers to flourish Build trusted partnerships with stakeholders to identify learning needs and create the right solutions. Commit to continuous improvement by embracing new ways of working, growing your own capability and contributing to the development of others. Your top five responsibilities Partner and challenge: Work closely with stakeholders to explore growth opportunities. Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions and help shape the right learning solution. Design, test and improve: Create engaging, discovery-led learning experiences. Pilot ideas before scaling, gather meaningful feedback and continuously refine solutions to maximise their impact. Support our learning ecosystem: Keep Thrive running smoothly by maintaining content, supporting users, monitoring learning data and reporting on what's working and where we can improve. Use AI with purpose: Embrace AI as part of your everyday workflow, identifying practical ways it can help us design, develop and deliver learning more efficiently, while applying critical thinking to ensure quality always comes first. Facilitate and contribute: Facilitate learning sessions, including our Laminar Way series, and contribute to a wide range of L&D initiatives, building your facilitation skills and broadening your impact over time. Your Capabilities You'll thrive in this role if you're curious about how people learn and enjoy designing learning solutions that make a real difference. You're comfortable taking ownership, asking thoughtful questions and navigating ambiguity to find the best way forward. You enjoy variety and working across different parts of the L&D cycle. As a candidate, you should have: Must-Have (The fundamentals) Mastery: 2-4 years' experience in L&D, training design, facilitation, coaching, people development or consultancy. Understands what makes learning effective, from uncovering the real need to designing experiences that people can apply in their work. Curious about learning technology (no experience with Thrive or Rise 360 needed) and excited by the potential of AI to design and deliver learning more effectively, with the judgement to know when it adds value. A degree in Behavioural Science, Organisational Psychology, Educational Psychology, L&D or a related field is a bonus, not a requirement. Communication: Builds relationships easily and asks good questions to get to the real need behind a request. Communicates clearly, listens well, and adapts to the audience. Shares a point of view while staying open to feedback. Leadership: Takes initiative rather than waiting to be asked. Comfortable working through ambiguity, makes decisions within their remit, knows when to escalate, and is keen to grow in confidence and capability over time. Impact: An experience in taking ownership of projects and improving processes, and a genuine interest in growth. Like everyone at Laminar, you’ll have your own Individual Development Plan, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to use it to continue growing. Nice to have (or areas you'll develop with us) Mastery: Experience designing learning using Rise 360 and working with a Learning Management System. Some experience facilitating learning sessions, whether through training, workshops, coaching, teaching or knowledge-sharing. Communication: Experience working with different stakeholder groups or in a consultancy-style environment. Leadership: An interest in developing your facilitation skills and growing into more coaching-style conversations with stakeholders over time. Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team _____________________________________________________________________ Benefits The Standard Stuff Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft The Life-Changing Stuff In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being Flexibility : Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us _____________________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: Why do you want to join us? If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how? We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
description: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins. Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end. Overview As the Senior Growth Marketing Manager , you are responsible for spearheading Rithum’s digital advertising efforts and driving efficient client acquisition across online channels, with a strong emphasis on B2B Google search engine marketing (PPC). You own performance marketing strategy and execution end to end, partner with creative, product, and analytics teams, and are accountable for ROI, client acquisition, and revenue growth targets. At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance. Responsibilities Paid Media Strategy & Execution Spearhead digital advertising strategy, developing and executing performance marketing plans that drive efficient client acquisition, revenue growth, and ROI targets, with an emphasis on B2B Google search engine marketing (PPC). Manage digital advertising campaigns end to end, including planning, implementation, execution, optimization, and performance analysis. Execute and manage digital paid media plans for PPC and display on a real-time bidding platform. Monitor and optimize advertising budgets to ensure efficient allocation of resources and maximize ROI. Deep understanding of content strategy for paid media and be able to work cross-group collaboratively with the content team and/or agency to outline and deliver needs. Search Platform Management Manage, review, and perform daily account responsibilities for Google Ads and other search platforms. Maintain and monitor keyword bids, daily and monthly budget caps, impression share, quality score, audience lists, and other key account metrics. Manage the creation of large keyword lists and tie them consistently back to the overall SEM strategy. Testing, Analytics & Optimization Monitor KPIs including click-through rate, conversion rate across each funnel stage, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and lifetime value, and take proactive action to improve campaign performance. Conduct A/B and multivariate testing on ad variations, messaging, and targeting parameters to maximize campaign effectiveness. Use data-driven insights to identify optimization opportunities across audience targeting, ad creative, bidding strategies, and landing pages. Conduct deep-dive analysis to answer specific business questions, uncover insights, and recommend improvements to digital marketing strategies and tactics. Reporting, Collaboration & Innovation Build digital marketing analytics dashboards and prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports and presentations that communicate results, insights, and recommendations to key stakeholders. Collaborate with creative, product, and analytics teams to align and integrate marketing efforts, and manage relationships with external agencies, vendors, and partners to support campaign execution. Embed AI into campaign planning, audience analysis, creative testing, and reporting, and share effective prompts and workflows across teams. Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in growth marketing, and incorporate innovative strategies into campaigns. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of experience in B2B Google search, digital advertising, growth marketing, or a related field, driving measurable results against ROI targets. Proficiency in digital advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Twitter Ads, and other relevant channels. Hands-on experience with performance marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Facebook Business Manager. Proficiency using analytics tools such as Excel, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Tableau, or Domo to drive business insights. Experience measuring and monitoring performance of brand search keyword campaigns versus non-brand search campaigns. Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision-making. Preferred Qualifications 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, growth marketing, or a related field. Bachelor's degree in the applicable discipline or related field preferred. Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment, with deep knowledge of B2B client behaviors and growth marketing trends. Experience creating targeted lists in Salesforce and leveraging 6sense. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions. Project management skills, including prioritizing and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Creative, problem-solving mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets and KPIs. Travel Required Up to 10% Other Duties Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. title: Clinical Research Associate II - FSP
description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about supporting professional growth and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a midsized CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most with support from direct line management. To support continued growth from our clients, we are hiring all levels of CRAs experienced in monitoring Oncology, Cardiology, or Lupus, Position Summary: The CRA II is a seasoned, experienced professional in monitoring and site management. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the CRA II is assigned and typically include activities involving start-up and study implementation, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents work independently as a study team member. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: Oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports. Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions. Updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports. If required, manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager. If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee. Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues. Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/ qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote). Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution. Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations. Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues. Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image. Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned. Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies. Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process. Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with minimal support from project team. Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. Travels as necessary according to project needs. Performs other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications: Minimum Required: 4-year college degree or equivalent experience in a scientific or healthcare discipline. Two (2) years or more as a CRA in a CRO or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies. Site management or equivalent experience in clinical research Other Required: Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential. A team player. Evidence of a client focused approach Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail. Ability to travel overnight. Up to 60% travel on average, based on regional requirements. International travel as needed. Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based Preferred: Graduate or postgraduate degree Lupus monitoring experience Experience monitoring in rare and complex therapeutic areas Experience monitoring EDC trials and EHR records Experience in biopharma or relevant therapeutic area Relevant site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, submissions) experience for the particular country Ability to monitor study sites, with supervision, according to protocol monitoring guidelines, SOPs, GCP and ICH guidelines. Ability to resolve project related problems and prioritizes workload to meet deadlines with minimal support from management. Competencies: Exhibits self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment Understands clinical trials methodology, including a working knowledge of protocols and indications being studied Demonstrates professionalism as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, an understanding of the service culture and positive interactions with customers and teammates, including good interpersonal skills Collects data of consistently high standard Demonstrated ability to conduct formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including colleagues, investigative staff, and clients with a high level of proficiency Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based About Precision for Medicine Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offerings enable the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for complex disease states. Precision medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer. We strike tumors on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway. We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving clients that are researching groundbreaking therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated through a multitude of benefits including paid time off, volunteer time off, robust medical offerings, non-vested 401k plus company match, paid parental leave and more. At Precision, your ideas and contributions are valued and nurtured, impacting positive change for the company. This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. title: Account Manager (West Coast, NZ)
description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the West Coast region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand. Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the South Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have. Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the West Coast region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position. What your day could look like Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region. Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business. Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance. Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system. Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding. Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success. Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency. Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections. Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals. Technical Expertise : Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy. Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles. We’re backing potential over polish. These are the traits that matter most A great human first You bring integrity, humility, and care. You do what you say you’ll do. You show up for your farmers and your teammates. Lifelong learner mindset You’re genuinely curious. You ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to keep leveling up alongside a world‑class team. Hunger and grit You love chasing ambitious goals, solving hard problems, and sticking with it when things get tough. Positive energy and team spirit You lift the people around you, not drain them. You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and celebrating others’ wins as much as your own. Comfort in a fast‑moving environment You’re at your best when things are dynamic. You can work autonomously, manage your time well, and stay focused on what matters most. Experience that helps you hit the ground running A background in relationship management, account management, sales, or working closely with customers. Experience in dairy or the wider ag sector is a bonus, but not a deal breaker if you bring strong learning agility and a genuine passion for helping farmers succeed. A foundation of business acumen and a willingness to deepen it on the job. If you’re excited by the idea of working with an exceptional South Island team, spending time on farm with great people, and helping farmers become leaders in productivity and sustainability, we’d love to hear from you. Who we’re looking for 3-5 years of experience in relationship management/account management roles. Experience in dairy farming or within the agriculture sector with a deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Strong business acumen. Positive attitude and collaborative team player who excels at overcoming challenges. The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy. A hunger for success and personal growth, and an eagerness to evolve alongside a world-class team. Our Benefits Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being. We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family. Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave. Join our team Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit! If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch! Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram . Why our team loves working at Halter: Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations. Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems. You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund. This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Technical Account Manager
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. Role Summary: As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the proactive partner responsible for ensuring new and existing clients successfully achieve their strategic outcomes using Ping Identity solutions. Operating within the Global Support Organization, you will guide the customer’s journey from purchase to production, reviewing configurations and translating complex use cases into sound product architecture. By regularly engaging with customer leadership (up to the Director and VP levels) and taking full ownership of your accounts' technical trajectory, you will ensure customers are fully optimized and continuously receiving value from their Ping investments. You will: Provide proactive technical recommendations, architectural reviews, and best practices for Ping solutions tailored to the customer's identity and security needs. Conduct regular environment health reviews and business reviews to highlight success against goals and ensure full value adoption. Act as the voice of the customer, advocating for product features and internal roadmap adjustments that drive long-term operational success. Adopt and utilize internal AI tools to generate customer reports, technical recommendations, and data-driven insights to boost daily productivity. Take full accountability for the technical trajectory of your accounts, ensuring no ball is dropped between the customer and internal Ping teams. Identify opportunities to improve internal reporting and automate status tracking to better visualize customer health. Contribute to internal Knowledge Bases (KBs) and support the onboarding of new TAMs by sharing operational best practices. Represent the TAM role with professionalism during internal summits and occasionally act as a liaison during off-hours for critical customer upgrades. You have: Must have enterprise customer-facing experience in a Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, or Professional Services role. Foundational knowledge of the cybersecurity domain, including common security technologies, enterprise network architectures, and basic threat landscapes. Familiarity with leveraging standard AI productivity tools to enhance daily workflows, streamline communication, and generate basic data-driven insights. Understanding of Java, web technologies, and enterprise architecture. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build credible, transparent relationships with customer leaders. Experience with Identity Management, Access Management, or Federation. Ability to manage both proactive and reactive tasks effectively while demonstrating high ownership. Experience with SFDC or equivalent CRM systems. On-call availability may be a requirement for this position. You have an advantage if: Experience with Ping Identity solutions and APIs. Experience with Windows and Linux operating systems. General networking knowledge of protocols like HTTP/S, TCP/IP. General knowledge of protocols such as SAML, OAuth, or OpenID Connect. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. title: Global Controller
description: About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Diep N, VP, Finance at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Global Controller to take the close, the books, and our control environment and make them theirs. We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, and as we grow we need a controller who can lead the team already in place and sharpen the fundamentals. You'll lead a team of ~7, growing, across revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury, and partner closely with me and, given our CFO's broad remit, with stakeholders across Sales, Legal, IT, HR, and Engineering. What you'll do Lead monthly and quarterly close, GL, AP/AR, payroll, and account reconciliations, delivering accurate, timely US GAAP financials. Close currently runs ~10 business days; get us to 6-8 days within your first 12 months, with fewer post-close adjustments and aged reconciliations. Own revenue accounting and serve as our technical accounting authority on subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606), including the ARR-to-GAAP bridge: reconciling ARR, billings, deferred revenue, contract assets, and usage true-ups to reported revenue, and explaining the delta to leadership and the board in plain terms. Author technical accounting position memos on contract modifications, SSP allocation, variable consideration, and capitalized contract costs, the work that makes "technical accounting authority" real. Own equity compensation accounting (ASC 718): grant accuracy, 409A timing, expense, modifications, and cap-table integrity, in partnership with stock plan administration. Manage and grow a team of ~7, with room to scale, building trust quickly and developing the leads beneath you. Build a control framework suited to a global, remote-first, private company with subscription and usage-based revenue, keeping the books audit-ready. Own our accounting systems roadmap and drive automation across close and reporting. Own select treasury operations, including cash management and banking relationships, and partner on FX exposure monitoring given our multi-currency footprint. Run our external audit relationship and coordinate with external tax partners on compliance, provisions, and filings. Manage the realities of a distributed, remote-first global team: statutory accounting coordination, payroll and contractor controls, entity reporting, and working with Legal, HR, and Tax on international compliance. What we're looking for 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leading a team through managers or leads. A Big 4 (or equivalent top-tier public accounting) foundation. Deep US GAAP mastery, particular strength in subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606). A concrete, personally-owned automation or AI deployment in accounting with a measurable result, eliminating a manual reconciliation, reducing close time, or lowering error rate, that you can speak to in detail. Experience scaling an accounting function that was already running, not building one from zero. A proven track record with external audits and keeping books audit-ready. Strong leadership and communication skills, with credibility partnering with senior, cross-functional stakeholders. Nice to have: internal controls or SOX-readiness experience; remote-first/globally distributed company experience; M&A or deal accounting exposure; CPA license, active or inactive. Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role ranges from $250k to $280k USD (or equivalent in local currency), structured by geographic zone and depending on experience. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute recruiter screen 45-minute hiring manager screen Two 30-minute cross-functional chats: one with a Legal partner, one with a People partner 60-minute case review call 30-minute bar raiser call with our CFO All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

title: Senior Phishing Tradecraft Researcher
description: What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. Reports to: Manager, Product Research Location: Remote US Compensation Range: $170,000.00 to $185,000.00 base plus bonus and equity What You’ll Do: Do you like getting into the weeds on all things technical, psychological, and educational, and have a desire to know how things work? Then this is the position for you. We are looking for that Swiss Army Knife that brings broad experience to each challenge presented. The Huntress Product team has the unique honor of waking up every morning knowing we’re going to make hackers regret targeting our partners and customers. As a Senior Product Researcher for our Security Awareness Training product, we’re looking for someone who wants to pour all of their creativity into building and implementing simple solutions that are disproportionately effective at countering these constantly evolving threats. One should have experience managing, deploying, and securing SMB environments utilizing a wide variety of security software, best practices, and automation tools. Familiarity with product management, incident response, social engineering, psychology, education, and managed service provider tools is an additional way to differentiate yourself. Responsibilities: Operate a proven industry-leading Security Awareness Training phishing program. Be the security expert designing and building phishing scenario emails & landing pages that simulate real cyber attacks for thousands of SAT learners. Every simulation is paired with coaching that shows learners the social engineering tells, how the learner can develop skills to identify social engineering tradecraft, the indicators, like hovering a link before clicking or receiving an unexpected email. Craft a growing library of common indicators and write new ones when a scenario calls for it. Comfortable scripting and coding to build proofs-of-concept and tooling with a keen eye for creating pixel-perfect simulated phishing emails & landing pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, & React. Take pride in delivering simulations impossible to distinguish from real tradecraft. The details are the job. Identify emerging social engineering tradecraft from attack patterns, email metadata, and web expertise. Today ClickFix attacks and variants dominate the threat landscape, but relentless hunger to get ahead of attacker tradecraft will mean translating the shifts in attacker tactics that matter into what the program teaches. Evolve deliverables with the tradecraft. Automate by default, evolving + expanding phishing content generation as an AI-powered system using Claude Code. Expand the program into new regions, more languages, more tailored content, and new kinds of learning experiences with the guidance of the Product Manager and Principal Product Researcher. Triage reported phishing emails, internal and external security incidents surfacing threat insights and trend analysis in the Huntress Threat Report, threat advisories, social media engagements, webinars & conference talks, resulting in strategic security awareness outreach campaigns. Align with the Principal Researcher to deliver unified Security Awareness Training and phishing program outcomes. Proven organizational and project management skills, with a keen attention to detail and sense of urgency to deliver an exceptional product under tight deadline pressures. Eagerness to engage, report, and be accountable to executive stakeholders. Passion to translate your expertise in technical & nontechnical ways to deliver impactful security outcomes that protect the 99%. What You Bring To The Team: Proficiency with HTML, CSS, Javascript & React, Angular, or Vue Proficiency with Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor with impressive projects to prove it Experience in manually building phishing simulation deliverables like emails and landing pages, simulating phishing attacks, then analyzing & reporting simulation results Experience triaging reported phishing emails, security incidents, and identifying trends + patterns Experience in analyzing, tracking, and defending against phishing attacks Experience identifying emerging tradecraft Social engineering experience, coursework, training, certifications Experience innovating training content Experience with eLearning design and development Experience developing marketing content for social media, YouTube, blogs & reports Spanish language skills desired, but not required What We Offer: 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015 Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays 12 weeks of paid parental leave Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution Life and Disability insurance plans Stock options for all full-time employees One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance $75 USD/month digital reimbursement Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.
