Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: Focus on the mission Build great things that help humans Demonstrate grit Never stop learning Pursue excellence We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML Systems Engineer to join Quilter's Placer Team and build the infrastructure that moves research from prototype to production reliably and efficiently. The Role The Placer is responsible for automated component placement on PCBs. This role focuses on the systems and infrastructure that support the full ML lifecycle: training pipelines, data generation and cleaning, experiment management, orchestration, serving, A/B testing, and CI/CD. You'll be building the infrastructure that moves research from prototype to production reliably and efficiently. You'll also play a key role in systems design review and long-range architectural planning as the team scales. This is a fully distributed team. We expect high autonomy and high ownership. What Youʼll Do Design, build, and maintain ML infrastructure across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring Own data pipelines including generation, cleaning, validation, and versioning Build and improve experiment tracking, orchestration, and reproducibility tooling Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and A/B testing infrastructure Lead and formalize design review processes across the team Identify architectural risks early and guide the team toward sustainable systems decisions What Weʼre Looking For 7+ years of industry experience building and operating ML systems in production Proven track record as a key player in the success of a production-grade ML system end-to-end Deep familiarity with training pipelines, serving infrastructure, and experiment management Strong software engineering fundamentals and systems design sensibility Experience driving design reviews and improving engineering processes within a team Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces Experience with GPU-accelerated workloads and orchestration Strong communication and collaboration skills Preferred 7+ years of industry experience Familiarity with ML workflows involving optimization, RL, or combinatorial problems Experience building infrastructure for small, research-heavy teams Please note : We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent. What we offer: Interesting and challenging work Competitive salary and equity benefits Health, dental, and vision insurance Regular team events and offsites (~4x / year) Unlimited paid time off Paid parental leave Want to learn more about Quilter, our vision, and our investors? Visit our About page and visit our Blog .

title: Sales Engineer (French) SMB
description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. The 1Password Sales Engineering team is a valuable resource to our customers and fellow Go-to-Market team members. Our Sales Engineers are well known and respected as experts on the product, trusted advisors to our sales teams and customers, and a sought-after resource for various types of customer calls. The team collaborates with Product, Marketing, Enablement, and Support to create resources, provide training opportunities, and elevate the overall understanding of 1Password. We are a kind, curious, approachable, and customer-focused team on a mission to drive the vision of 1Password forward. As a Sales Engineer for the SMB segment, you will be a trusted technical advisor, driving revenue growth, improving win rates, and accelerating deal velocity through strategic technical guidance. Partnering closely with Account Executives, you will position 1Password's multi-product solution spanning Extended Privilege Management (EPM), SaaS Manager, and Device Trust to meet each customer's needs, often through leading and managing proof-of-concept (POC) engagements that validate technical success criteria and support adoption. You will navigate high-volume, fast-paced SMB sales cycles, uncovering opportunities to position the full product suite and applying frameworks like MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities, address requirements, and influence decision-makers. You will also support customers with compliance needs by responding to security questionnaires, RFPs/RFIs, and vendor registration requirements. You will bring credibility with both security and technical buyers, including those evaluating or transitioning from developer-centric secrets management tools. As 1Password's portfolio evolves toward Unified Access, your ability to bridge human identity (EPM), application access (SaaS Manager), and endpoint trust (Device Trust) with the emerging machine identity and secrets automation narrative will be a differentiator in every deal. As a subject matter expert across all 1Password products, you will collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Marketing, and Customer Experience to create resources, enablement materials, and customer-facing content that drive adoption, improve close rates, and deliver measurable business impact. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. This is a remote opportunity within the UK. What we're looking for: At least 2 years of experience in a technical customer-facing role (B2B SaaS, preferably in the SMB segment or similar). Ability to communicate in French fluently Ability to communicate technical information clearly and confidently to a wide range of audiences, including non-technical stakeholders. Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, making complex information sound simple and relevant. Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to quality, even in high-volume environments. Enthusiasm for learning, testing, and problem-solving. You are curious and dig in when a customer has a challenge. Strong time-management skills with the ability to effectively prioritize competing tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment. Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, remote-first team. Open to learning and able to adapt quickly, working across multiple products and shifting priorities with a flexible and proactive mindset. Experience in or strong familiarity with the security and identity space, including credential management, privileged access, or secrets management. Prior exposure to tools such as HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, or similar PAM and secrets platforms is a significant advantage. Familiarity with relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) is strongly preferred. Comfortable navigating developer-centric conversations, including how teams manage secrets in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI), container environments (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure). title: Account Executive
description: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. AI is fundamental to how we work AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at. What we're looking for: We're hiring an Account Executive to close enterprise deals with energy retailers, and turn their customers EVs, heat pumps and batteries into flexible capacity the grid can actually use. Every retailer in Europe knows they need to do this. Very few have done it yet. The distance between a board approving a smart charging proposition and a customer plugging in at three in the morning because the price is low is where this role sits, and it gets closed by someone who can carry the commercial case and the technical one in the same conversation. Six months from now, this seat should mean every qualified opportunity in your markets has one person accountable for it, and the pattern of what actually wins is written down rather than held in someone's head. You'll report to Enode's VP of Revenue, who leads sales, customer success, customer engineering, marketing and partnerships. You'll join a team of account executives, working alongside customer success on the accounts you win and directly with our customer engineering managers through technical validation on every deal. You will carry a number and shape how we sell at the same time. There is more room to influence the motion here than at a company where it is already settled, and more expectation that you will use it. In this role, you will: Own scoping, technical validation, negotiation and contracting for energy retailers and strategic accounts for your segment, and carry the number. Become the person a Head of Product or Head of Innovation at a energy retailer calls before they have a formal project, because you understand their proposition and their market better than they expect from a vendor. Map the full stakeholder landscape on every live deal, including the champions nobody introduces you to. Retailers buy this through a committee that spans product, IT, trading and procurement. Build the case that makes a slow buyer move: what the alternative costs them, where a different approach falls short, why this budget cycle rather than the next one. Scope a use case across Connect, our optimisation tooling and Flex without needing an engineer in the room, and know exactly when to pull a customer engineering manager in. Run technical validation with your customer engineering counterpart, from the first sandbox conversation to an integration the customer trusts in production. Turn your own wins into the materials, sequences and objection handling the rest of the team reuses, so the second deal of a given shape is faster than the first. This role will be right for you, if: You have closed technical B2B deals with a real cycle, six months rather than six weeks, and you can name the specific things you did that moved them forward. You are more curious about how a customer's business works than about your own pitch, which is why you can hold a conversation about tariff design or device coverage without reaching for a demo. You are not put off by the fact that the playbook does not exist yet, because you would rather write it than inherit it. You do not need to have sold into energy before, but you should be able to say why you want to in terms more specific than caring about the climate. Must haves Three or more years closing B2B deals you owned end to end, ideally technical or API led products. Comparable experience leading commercial projects with senior stakeholders also counts. Strong understanding of the sales motion for API products. Evidence of owning a market or segment independently, rather than working leads handed to you. Ability to multi-thread across product, IT and procurement, including stakeholders nobody introduces you to. Willingness to learn the domain properly: energy retail, consumer tariffs, demand-side flexibility, connected devices. Based in Europe and able to travel for customer meetings and three off-sites a year. Nice to haves Experience selling to energy retailers, utilities, e-mobility companies or B2B SaaS platforms. Experience at a company where the sales motion was still being invented rather than inherited. A second European language. What we offer: Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale. A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition. Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey. Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that. Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly. Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand. Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places. Flexible, human-first culture. Stipend for setting up your home office. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A few things to note: Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles. Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
description: The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it. We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact. Your mission: Own the design experience of Klim end to end, and build the AI-augmented design process that lets a small design team and product managers ship coherent, high-quality work at scale. You'll do the hardest design work yourself and raise the level of everyone who designs around you. This means it is a player/coach role with 60% hands-on design and 40% building the system and process around you. What you'll do Product experience: Own the end-to-end experience across farmer and partner journeys, from onboarding through assessment, planning and improvement, verification and reporting and paymnet, shaping journeys and value moments with product managers, not only interfaces. Design the most complex and brand-critical work, from wireframes and flows to polished, high-fidelity interaction and visual design. Cut farmer effort, with a focus on "enter once, used everywhere" data capture, simpler onboarding and self-serve help. Run continuous research, usability testing and A/B tests with farmers and partners, and track experience metrics (activation, task completion, time-to-value, satisfaction) with product and analytics. AI-augmented design process: Own and deliver Klim's AI-augmented design model maintaining highest quality while enabling others to deliver simpler design needs under your guidance Own the canonical design system with engineering: components and page templates, with code as the source of truth and Figma kept in sync. Define the handoff contract and the automated and human coherence checks, using AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma, Storybook) and rules AI tools can follow. Measure and improve the process: self-serve share, first-pass coherence, review time, engineering rework and ticket-to-design lead time. Engineering efficiency and quality: Partner with engineering leads to simplify and standardise how UI is built, so new features reuse proven patterns instead of starting from scratch. Reduce design-related rework by making requirements, states and edge cases explicit before build. Govern the intake of new patterns and log any exceptions, so the system grows deliberately rather than drifting. Coach: Enable product managers to design simpler elements well within the system through templates, patterns, content rules and review. Build design rituals (critique, design reviews, a shared quality bar) and make the case for design decisions with evidence across product, engineering and commercial teams. What you bring: 5+ years in product design, including senior or lead roles owning complex B2B or data-heavy products end to end. Exceptional interaction and visual design craft, with mastery of Figma. You'll personally deliver the most complex and brand-critical work. A portfolio that shows product-level impact (engagement, adoption, satisfaction), not only interface quality. Proven ability to improve engagement and strong plus for experience running A/B tests and product experiments and strong research skills. Proven experience building and running a design system with engineering, ideally in React and Storybook, with tokens and components treated as code. Hands-on use of AI tools in design and delivery (e.g. Claude, Figma AI or similar), and a clear view of where they help and where they don't. A track record of designing processes others adopt, coaching designers and enabling non-designers, while still doing strong hands-on work. Clear communication with farmers, engineers and executives alike. Fluent English. Nice to have: German, to speak directly with farmers. Experience in agriculture, climate, sustainability or other multi-sided platforms. Experience with multi-language products and content design. Why join Klim Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact: Your work helps farmers move to regenerative practice and helps companies cut supply-chain emissions. Ownership: you'll set how design works at Klim, with direct access to leadership and a clear influence on the product roadmap. Competitive package: competitive salary and participation in our VSIP program. Flexible work: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate temporary remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket (if based in Germany), a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. description: Title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern Type of contract: Paid internship Contract duration: 6 months Work time: Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time Reporting to: Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator Technical guidance: BI and Systems Officer Location: Remote (home-based outside Switzerland) Start date: January 2027 Application deadline: 10/12/2026 Background The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work. Role Summary The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements. Position Responsibilities Systems and User Support Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day; Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews; Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases; Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly. Data Quality and Information Management Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues; Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance; Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions; Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions. Documentation, Training and Continuity Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials; Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities; Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates; Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement. Position Requirements Education and Experience The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship; Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management; Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset. Other Requirements Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset. Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality; Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately; Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment; Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology. title: Engineering Manager, Payments (all genders)
description: About us Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. The opportunity We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Payments engineering team within the E-commerce department. Payments takes, refunds and reconciles customer money across our white-label booking sites, subscriptions and in-person sales points, integrating with providers such as Adyen, PayPal and Checkout.com. Correctness, reliability and security are non-negotiable. You might lead more than one team from the start, and as the department grows, the scope of this role can expand to other engineering areas. We need someone with real payments depth who also wants to grow as a multi-team leader. We invest in AI-assisted development, from shared agent skills to AI-driven SDLC tooling, and we expect our leaders to shape how their teams work with it. What you will do: Lead several engineering teams, working through tech leads to set direction, priorities and delivery across them. Hire, coach and grow senior engineers and future leaders. Own performance, career development and team structure as the area scales. Own the health of our payment platform: reliability, idempotency, provider failover, webhook handling and incident response. Shape the roadmap with Product, balancing new payment methods and markets against platform investment, cost and provider fees. Partner with White Label, Orders, Finance and Data teams on checkout, refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation and the payment ledger. Stay close to system design and architecture of our event-driven services (Ruby, Kafka), and set the technical bar across your teams. Raise the bar on ownership: documentation, runbooks, observability and on-call. Champion AI-assisted engineering across your teams: coding agents, AI code review, test generation and documentation. Measure which practices improve delivery and quality. Define safe guardrails for AI use where money moves: human review, test coverage and auditability stay non-negotiable. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: An experienced Engineering Manager who has led multiple teams or a team of senior engineers. Required: hands-on background in payments. You've built or run payment systems in production, including PSP integrations, refunds and chargebacks, reconciliation and recurring billing. You understand PCI DSS, SCA/3DS and what it takes to keep money flows auditable. An engineer at heart, with experience in event-driven distributed systems (Kafka or similar) and strong skills in a modern backend language. Ruby is a plus. You're comfortable working across teams and departments, and you communicate clearly in writing in English. You use AI tools in your own day-to-day work, not just in theory. You've helped a team adopt them, and you can tell real productivity gains from hype. Nice to have: card-present/terminal payments, SEPA direct debit, multi-currency, travel or marketplace experience. What you can expect: Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide. Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions. Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions. Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day. Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow. title: Enterprise Applications Engineer, Zendesk
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this Role</strong></h2> <p>As an Enterprise Application Developer at GitLab, you'll build and maintain the custom applications and internal platforms that GitLab Support teams rely on to do their best work. This is a centralised application development role within the Enterprise AI team. You'll build it, ship it, and own it: software used right across the company, taken from specification through to a running, well-maintained service.</p> <p>You'll work in an AI-accelerated way. Modern AI coding tools are central to how this team builds, so strong engineering fundamentals matter more than ever. Clean, well-tested, maintainable code is what keeps an AI-assisted codebase from becoming a liability. You'll also be Customer Zero for GitLab's own platform and agentic development capabilities, helping us understand what world-class internal adoption and guardrails look like, and feeding that back to R&D.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the full platform lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization.</li> <li>Design, build, test, and maintain automated workflows, request forms, routing logic, approvals, SLAs, queues, and integrations across enterprise teams.</li> <li>Develop and manage integrations with platforms including Snowflake, Claude, Salesforce, Slack, GitLab, Zendesk, and internal application catalogs.</li> <li>Enable automated ticket creation, intelligent routing, provisioning, offboarding, and employee lifecycle processes.</li> <li>Partner with cross-functional stakeholders, application owners, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.</li> <li>Establish and maintain standards for security, compliance, auditability, documentation, and operational reliability.</li> <li>Lead platform modernization and automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to replace manual processes, improve self-service, and increase operational efficiency.</li> <li>Define governance practices and reusable standards for enterprise workflows, integrations, and support operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experienced Ruby developer with strong knowledge of GitLab, Zendesk, and Linux environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to translate technical solutions into practical, supportable operating processes—and to translate operational needs into effective technical designs.</li> <li>Advanced expertise in automation, workflow design, systems integration, and platform governance.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT or equivalent professional experience is required.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to design reliable solutions across complex technical and organizational environments.</li> <li>Experience working on projects with multiple stakeholders and knowledge of Change Management best practices is a plus.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills — technical writing experience a plus</li> <li>Well-organized, excellent work ethic, attention to detail, and self-starting</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving urgent, high-visibility technical problems</li> <li>Excellent problem solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The work is full-stack, fast, and pragmatic. This is a build-fast role, so expect rapid prototyping through to MVP and quick iteration on what you learn. You'll partner with business stakeholders to understand what they actually need, turn that into working software quickly, and own it once it's live. You won't have a full product-and-engineering pod around you, so you'll be comfortable picking up a spec, asking good questions, and driving it to completion.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: AI Research Engineer (Multi-Modal Agents)
description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale. You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly. You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity. Responsibilities Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices. Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking. Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding. Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution. Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces. Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification. Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy. Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable. Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks. Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang). Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Manager (Northland)
description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role. We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the Northland region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand. Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the North Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have. Location - This role is to be based in the Northern Northland region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position. What your day could look like. Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region. Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business. Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance. title: Webdesigner-/Entwickler – WordPress & AI (m/w/d)
description: Web Developer – WordPress & AI (m/w/d) Du denkst digital, liebst Technologie und findest, dass KI erst der Anfang ist? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Wir sind ANY Marketing – eine junge, dynamische Digitalagentur und Teil der The Radio Group. Während andere Radio machen, machen wir Radio und denken digital weiter. Wir entwickeln moderne Websites, individuelle Softwarelösungen, eigene Tools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden wir Kreativität, Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz mit der Reichweite und den Möglichkeiten eines Medienunternehmens. Unser Alltag? Alles außer Standard. Heute eine Website für den Bäcker um die Ecke, morgen ein digitales Projekt für einen Großkonzern und übermorgen vielleicht eine eigene Softwarelösung, die es so noch gar nicht gibt. Dafür suchen wir dich! Was dich bei uns erwartet Du konzipierst und entwickelst moderne, individuelle Websites auf Basis von WordPress und Breakdance. Du entwickelst eigene WordPress-Plugins, Schnittstellen und individuelle Funktionalitäten. Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv in deinem Entwicklungsalltag und entdeckst neue Möglichkeiten, Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter zu gestalten. Du begleitest digitale Kundenprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live. Du arbeitest an unseren eigenen digitalen Produkten, Plattformen und innovativen Anwendungen mit. Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und probierst neue Technologien aus. Was du mitbringen solltest Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress – und zwar über die reine Inhaltspflege hinaus. HTML, CSS, JavaScript und PHP sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung gesammelt, beispielsweise mit Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du hast ein Gespür für moderne Websites, gutes Design, Performance und Benutzerfreundlichkeit. Du arbeitest eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Du bist kommunikativ und hast keine Scheu vor dem direkten Kundenkontakt. Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast Lust, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Nice to have, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Breakdance oder vergleichbaren modernen WordPress-Buildern Erfahrung in der Entwicklung eigener WordPress-Plugins Kenntnisse in Next.js, React oder anderen modernen Webtechnologien Erfahrung mit APIs, Automatisierungen und KI-Agenten Kenntnisse in Git, Hosting und Deployment Du musst nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, Neues zu lernen, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Was wir dir bieten KI-first statt KI irgendwann: Bei uns ist künstliche Intelligenz kein Zukunftsthema, sondern gelebter Arbeitsalltag. Abwechslung garantiert: Spannende Projekte vom lokalen Handwerksbetrieb bis zum Großkonzern. Homeoffice: Flexibles Arbeiten, das zu deinem Alltag passt. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, mehr Umsetzung. Echte Kundennähe: Du erlebst unmittelbar, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht. Raum für deine Ideen: Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du Aufgaben abarbeitest, sondern dass du mitgestaltest. Moderne Technologien: Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Frameworks und KI-Anwendungen auszuprobieren und produktiv einzusetzen. Ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitsumfeld: Als Teil der The Radio Group arbeitest du mitten in der Medienwelt – zwischen Radiostudios, kreativen Köpfen, digitalen Innovationen und spannenden Persönlichkeiten. Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Offener Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und Spaß an dem, was wir tun. Perspektive: Gestalte mit uns den wachsenden digitalen Geschäftsbereich einer Mediengruppe aktiv mit. Dein Lebenslauf ist nicht dein Code. Ob du studiert hast, eine Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast oder dir das Entwickeln selbst beigebracht hast, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst, wie du denkst und wohin du dich entwickeln möchtest. Zeig uns gerne, woran du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Projekte dich begeistern oder wie du KI in deinem Alltag einsetzt. Wir wollen Menschen kennenlernen, keine perfekten Bewerbungsunterlagen. Let's build something great. Du hast Lust, gemeinsam mit uns die digitale Zukunft eines Medienunternehmens zu gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! The successful candidate will combine strong hands-on SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 development expertise with technical leadership, developer coordination and excellent stakeholder communication skills. The role is part of the maintenance workstream. Experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Multi Resource Scheduling (MRS), maintenance planning or production planning is highly desirable. You will act as the central technical point of contact between the development team, the implementation partner and the end customer. Project conditions: Start: ASAP Contract type: Freelance / B2B Duration: 12+ months Location: Germany preferred; nearshore possible with excellent German language skills Remote: Predominantly remote, with a maximum of one expected onsite day per month Language: Excellent German is mandatory Tasks Act as the central technical point of contact for SAP Fiori development within the maintenance workstream. Lead, coordinate and provide technical guidance to a team of SAP Fiori developers. Actively contribute to the design, development and implementation of SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 applications. Act as the technical interface between the development team, the implementation partner and the end customer. Translate business and technical requirements into reliable and scalable SAP Fiori solutions. Ensure consistent development quality, technical alignment and adherence to SAP development standards. Conduct code reviews and support technical architecture and design decisions. Identify and resolve complex development issues and proactively manage technical risks. Support testing, troubleshooting, performance optimisation and defect resolution. Promote independent, efficient and reliable delivery within a distributed development team. Requirements Extensive hands-on SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 development experience. Several successfully delivered SAP Fiori development projects in complex SAP environments. Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Development Lead, Lead Developer or SAP Fiori Architect with hands-on development responsibilities. Experience coordinating and technically guiding multiple developers. Strong understanding of SAP development architecture and development best practices. Excellent German language skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions and communicate directly with business stakeholders. Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills. High level of ownership, independence and proactivity. Availability to start as soon as possible. Preferred technical qualifications: SAP S/4HANA SAP Fiori Elements and Fiori Freestyle Development ABAP / ABAP Objects SAP OData Services CDS Views ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) SAP Gateway SAP Business Application Studio SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Technical architecture and solution design Clean Core principles and SAP development standards Code reviews and development quality assurance Highly desirable functional and industry experience: SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) SAP Customer Service (CS) SAP Multi Resource Scheduling (MRS) SAP Production Planning (PP) Mobile maintenance applications Maintenance planning and scheduling applications Planning boards and planning workbooks Maintenance orders, notifications and confirmations Railway, transportation, infrastructure, utilities or industrial manufacturing Previous experience working with an established SAP Fiori development team, or the ability to recommend developers from previous joint projects, would be a significant advantage. title: Senior Platform Engineer (w/m/d) (remote within the EU)
description: About Weflow Weflow is the Salesforce-native revenue intelligence platform for B2B sales teams. We capture sales activity, analyze conversations, run AI playbooks, and power forecasting and pipeline analytics, all inside Salesforce. We're a team of about 30 based in Berlin, and revenue teams run their day on our data. Your role You'll own the foundation the rest of engineering builds on: how we run in production, how we stay secure and audit-ready, and how we ship. It's a high-ownership role on a small team. You decide what matters most, build it, and make it stick. What you'll bring 5+ years in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, or software engineering, ideally at SaaS product companies. Hands-on experience operating production SaaS systems on AWS, with a strong grasp of AWS services and cloud architecture. Infrastructure as code, ideally with Terraform. A track record of building CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows, and of making developers faster. Production experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management. You can diagnose issues across infrastructure and application code. A strong understanding of distributed systems, networking, databases, and cloud security. Experience implementing security controls and supporting an external audit or certification such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Strong programming skills. You write maintainable code and build internal tools and automations that kill recurring work. You use AI in your daily development and actively look for workflows worth automating. Sound judgment about what to fix first and how much complexity a small team can maintain. You work independently and prioritize business impact. Working hours that overlap with CET ±2 hours. Nice to have Experience benchmarking infrastructure options or optimizing cloud costs. Familiarity with Salesforce or building integrations on top of it. Time at an early-stage startup where you built the platform, not just ran it. Your responsibilities Keep Weflow reliable. Own monitoring and alerting, improve visibility into production failures, and lead incident response with the engineering team. Fix recurring problems at the root and regularly verify that we can recover from failures. Own the engineering side of security and compliance. Improve cloud access controls, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain technical controls, gather evidence for our SOC 2 Type II audits, and drive engineering follow-up on audit findings. Improve how we build and ship. Own our CI/CD pipelines and make deployments and rollbacks safer. Make local development and staging easier to set up, use, and troubleshoot. Tackle new infrastructure challenges as we grow. Investigate problems across performance, scalability, and cloud costs. Prototype promising approaches, measure the results, and recommend what's worth putting into production. Why Weflow Real ownership : You set the direction for our platform from day one. No ticket queue, no layers of approval. Visible impact: Every reliability, security, or delivery win shows up directly in what customers experience and how fast we ship. A team that builds with AI: We use AI across the stack and want you to push that further in infrastructure. Compensation EUR 90,000–110,000 per year Available as contractor agreement or full-time employee position Application Submit your application through the platform, and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps. You’ll report directly to our Head of Social and Influencer, with direct support from our Creator Marketing Manager.</p> <p>Monzo is growing up, and we’re ready for our next stage of growth. We’re moving away from the old playbook to build a high-quality, always-on social and creator ecosystem with partners at the top of their game. This role is a great opportunity to work with some of the best in the game, and bring a fresh perspective to creator marketing at Monzo.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> Support talent onboarding and briefing, and day-to-day relationship management through our agency for our trusted ambassador roster.</li> <li><strong>Delivering compliant content: </strong>Review seamlessly alongside agency partners, internal brand, writers, social, and growth teams to align creator work with commercial goals.</li> <li><strong>Performance reporting:</strong> Track metrics, build reporting dashboards, and extract insights on media efficiency, brand lift, and engagement.</li> <li><strong>Trend & competitor tracking:</strong> Monitor competitor activity and emerging platform features to bring fresh, innovative ideas to the table.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 1–3 years’ experience in creator content deliverables and regulatory requirements.</li> <li>You’re a great communicator who can build trusting relationships with creators and collaborate with teams across the business.</li> activations, or ambassador programs.</li> <li>Understanding of social SEO, keyword optimisation, and search intent in creator content.</li> <li>Familiarity with creator management tools, social listening software, or analytics suites.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? title: Revenue Operations Manager
description: <p>Canonical has opened management positions for exceptional Revenue Operations leaders to grow our global direct, alliance, channel, partner and online sales. Our Revenue Operations teams analyse and drive interventions to maximise net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.</p> <p>As a Revenue Operations Manager you will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive process and system improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This role can be held remotely in all time zones.</p> <h2><strong>What your day will look like</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deliver precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels </li> <li>Develop and lead a team of revenue operations analysts in driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners</li> <li>Drive Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions</li> <li>Instrument, measure and improve processes across the entire revenue operations spectrum</li> <li>Deliver metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.  Use this data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.</li> <li>Oversee our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration</li> <li>Lead the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote</li> <li>Drive data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing </li> <li>Lead and enhance our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities </li> <li>Own the commission plan and lead the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a related field, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Experience operating in a senior leadership role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships, ideally within a similar technology subscription-based business</li> <li>Track record of providing insight through robust technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations</li> <li>Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organisation including managing a team of direct reports remotely in different time zones</li> <li>A thoughtful systematic approach, skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes</li> <li>Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure </li> <li>Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation </li> <li>Communication and negotiation skills to achieve buy-in to priorities from key stakeholders</li> <li>Fluent in business English (written and spoken)</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result.</li> <li>Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.</li> <li>Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.</li> <li>Analyze supply chain incidents and events.</li> <li>Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.</li> <li>Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.</li> <li>Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.</li> <li>Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks.</li> <li>Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).</li> <li>The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code.</li> <li>Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.</li> <li>An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends.</li> <li>The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.</li> <li>Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.</li> <li>Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering.</li> </ul> <p>You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.</p> <p>You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the <a href="https://advisories.gitlab.com">GitLab Advisory Database</a>, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/gitlab-discovers-widespread-npm-supply-chain-attack/">Shai-Hulud npm worm</a> and a <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/critical-rce-in-serena/">critical RCE in Serena</a>, a popular MCP coding agent. More on the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/categories/security-labs/">Security Labs blog</a>.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Founding Product Designer
description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still clicks through CAD trees, searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products : one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. Driving product initiatives with founders and engineers. Help frame the problem, facilitate decisions and turn a direction into projects and tasks the team can execute. Making the product coherent as it grows. Own interaction and visual quality, including the design system, without slowing down experimentation. WHAT WE CARE ABOUT You have shipped complex software products for expert users and can point to the decisions you made, not just the final screens. You are comfortable when the problem is not yet defined. You form your own opinion, push back and help create clarity. You have strong product judgment . You know when to research, when to prototype, when to polish and when to ship. You are comfortable working directly with customers and software engineers , and you learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You have strong interaction and visual craft and are comfortable with Figma, prototyping in code and AI-assisted workflows . You are fluent in German and English . Bonus: CAD, 3D, PLM, industrial software, AI agents or other highly technical products. None required. HOW TO APPLY Via Ashby with: Your CV Your portfolio – at least two case studies of complex B2B or AI products, showing your process, not just final screens A link to something you prototyped in code or with AI tools – rough is fine A 2-min intro video (any format you like) A short answer to: "What is the most complex workflow you have simplified – what made it hard, and what did you decide to leave out?" No recruiters, no portals. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Du baust als erste CRO-Person das Testing für Shops mit rund 250.000 Besuchen im Monat auf — und entscheidest selbst, was live geht. Die größte DTC-Marke unseres Kunden wächst im Direktgeschäft um rund 60 % pro Jahr, und Performance Marketing legt gerade kräftig nach. Allein in den letzten 30 Tagen kamen rund 250.000 Besuche in den Shop. Der Traffic ist also da — jetzt entscheidet sich, wie viel davon zu Umsatz wird. Dafür gibt es diese Rolle. Du holst Conversion Rate Optimization ins Haus und baust Testing-Prozess und Roadmap neu auf: Landingpages, Produktseiten, Homepage, Cart und Checkout. Das Ziel ist klar: den Umsatz pro Besucher in den ersten 6–12 Monaten um 40–50 % steigern. Du nimmst Tests selbst live und rollst Gewinner selbst aus, ein eigener Entwickler setzt um. Was in unserem größten Shop funktioniert, wird zum Playbook für die ganze Gruppe — mit der Perspektive, CRO gruppenweit zu verantworten. Warum es diese Rolle gibt Supplement Hub ist über starke Produkte und Amazon groß geworden. Im Direktgeschäft wächst unsere größte Marke schnell — mit über 200.000 Kund:innen. CRO lief bisher über eine Agentur. Das reicht für das, was jetzt kommt, nicht mehr: Mit jedem Euro mehr im Performance Marketing wird jeder Prozentpunkt Conversion wertvoller. Deshalb holen wir das Thema ins Haus. Das DTC-Team wird gerade neu aufgebaut. Wir suchen niemanden, der Agentur-Ergebnisse durchwinkt, sondern jemanden, der die Zielgruppe so gut versteht, dass daraus Tests mit echtem Umsatzhebel entstehen. Bedürfnisse, Einwände und Kaufängste sind erforscht — mit Microsoft Clarity, Shop-Daten, Reviews und Umfragen — und fließen direkt in deine Hypothesen. Die Test-Roadmap läuft. Hypothesen werden nach ICE priorisiert, im wöchentlichen Testing Call mit dem Head of DTC abgestimmt und Woche für Woche live genommen. Die Shops verkaufen besser. Landingpages, Produktseiten, Cart und Checkout sind getestet und optimiert — Copy, Layout, Bundles und Angebote eingeschlossen. Gewinner sind ausgerollt, Learnings dokumentiert. Jeder Test ist sauber ausgewertet und so festgehalten, dass er für die nächste Marke der Gruppe nutzbar ist. Der Umsatz pro Besucher ist spürbar gestiegen — und du kannst genau zeigen, welche Tests dazu beigetragen haben. Wie hier gearbeitet wird Supplement Hub ist effizienzgetrieben: Calls gibt es, wenn sie nötig sind, Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen. Du nimmst Tests eigenständig live und rollst Gewinner eigenständig aus. Abstimmen musst du dich nur, wenn ein Angebotstest live laufende Ads betrifft — zum Beispiel rund um Black Friday. Ein Entwickler baut deine Tests technisch und pflegt sie in Intelligems ein. Du konzipierst, er setzt um. Gesetzt sind Shopify Plus, Intelligems und Microsoft Clarity. Du kannst an Zahlen zeigen, was deine Tests gebracht haben: Conversion Rate, Umsatz pro Besucher oder Warenkorb vorher und nachher. Erfahrung mit einem Shop in relevanter Größe, idealerweise ab rund 10 Mio. € Jahresumsatz. Shopify kennst du aus dem Alltag, Signifikanz und Testlaufzeit sind für dich kein Fremdwort. Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, weil du Copy für deutschsprachige Kund:innen schreibst. Du musst nicht selbst coden — du konzipierst, die Umsetzung ist da. Traffic, der schnell Ergebnisse liefert. Rund 250.000 Besuche im Monat — deine Tests werden zügig signifikant. Ein Mentor als Chef. title: Sr. Customer Success Manager (French Speaking)
description: About You You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Lead escalations with clarity and urgency by defining the business impact, engaging the right internal teams, setting expectations, and maintaining customer confidence through resolution. Advocate effectively for customer needs while exercising strong judgment about when engineering involvement is required, how requests should be prioritized, and when an alternative solution can deliver the desired outcome. Use customer insights, performance data, and ecommerce best practices to provide proactive, strategic recommendations, not simply respond to requests. Maintain clear success plans, stakeholder maps, account documentation, training materials, and agreed actions so that both the customer and Constructor teams remain aligned. Partner closely with Account Management to support retention and growth by demonstrating value, strengthening executive relationships, and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership. Continuously improve how we onboard, integrate, and support customers, sharing repeatable best practices that make our processes more scalable and the customer experience more effective.
