Strong executive presence and the confidence to lead strategic customer conversations, including QBRs and EBRs. Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to create momentum and drive progress without direct authority. Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving, technically sophisticated environment. title: General Ledger Manager, Accounting
description: fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products. As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on. About this role: fal is growing fast, and our accounting team is building toward a first Big 4 audit. We're looking for a hands-on GL Manager who can own core close areas end to end and step in wherever the team needs help. This is a generalist role: you'll own payroll accounting, partner API costs and revenue share, support technical accounting and our ERP work, and pick up ad hoc projects as the business changes. It suits someone who likes variety, works well with ambiguity and uses AI tools to work faster. What you’ll do Payroll accounting: book payroll, benefits and related accruals each month from Rippling. Reconcile payroll liabilities and work with HR and payroll on corrections. Partner API accounting: monthly accruals, prepaids and true-ups for partner API vendors. Reconcile vendor usage to invoices and the GL. Revenue share: calculate, accrue and reconcile revenue-share payments to partners from usage and partner reports. Month-end close: prepare journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and flux analysis for your areas, and help hit the close timeline. Support technical accounting: book entries from technical conclusions (for example, lease entries under ASC 842) and maintain the supporting schedules. ERP and systems support: help with the ERP selection and migration, chart of accounts clean-up, and mapping data from Ramp, Rippling and billing systems. Generalist and ad hoc support Cover other close areas when needed (prepaids, accruals, fixed assets, intercompany, cash). Answer audit requests (PBCs) and prepare support for auditors and other advisors. Take on one-off projects: new vendor or contract types, policy write-ups, process clean-ups, data pulls for leadership. Write down processes so others can repeat them, and help build controls as we prepare for audit. Back up teammates during busy periods or time off. How you'll work Use AI tools (such as Claude) to automate recurring work like reconciliations, accruals and tie-outs. Review the output and own the final numbers. Work closely with Ops, HR, FP&A, the offshore AP team and the Assistant Controller. Be precise and quick at the same time. Flag issues early and explain your numbers clearly. Qualifications/Nice-to-haves 5–7 years of accounting experience, including GL and month-end close ownership. Public accounting (Big 4 preferred) plus industry experience is a plus. Strong US GAAP knowledge: accruals, prepaids, payroll, revenue share or royalty arrangements; exposure to ASC 842 leases. Experience at a high-growth startup or tech company. You're comfortable with changing priorities and work that isn't fully defined. Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. Experience with Ramp, Rippling, QuickBooks or NetSuite is a plus. Experience supporting an external audit. Hands-on use of AI tools in your accounting work. CPA preferred. ERP implementation or migration experience. Usage-based or API business experience (AI, cloud or SaaS). Experience writing accounting policies and process documentation. What we offer at fal Interesting and challenging work A lot of learning and growth opportunities We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco. Health, dental, and vision insurance (US) Regular team events and offsites U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY INFORMATION: fal provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law. title: Senior Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.</p> <p>You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/chatops/">A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</a></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li>Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li>Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.</li> <li>Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.</li> <li>Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.</li> <li>Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> <li>Fluent Korean language skills (required)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack. We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/"> Support Team page</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Engineering Productivity Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an EngProd Engineer to join our Engineering Operations team and own the engineering experience from local setup to production deploy. You’ll build and integrate the tools our engineers rely on every day: local development, code search, testing, code review, CI, AI-assisted workflows, and the metrics that show where time is being lost. You’ll work closely with other engineering teams at Supabase to eliminate friction, optimize cycle times, and make reliably shipping to production effortless. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that engineers love and that empower them to do their best work. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Improve local development and the daily workflow - Own local development environment stability; eliminate “works on my machine,” keep environments reproducible across teams, and make onboarding and setup self-service for every engineer - Improve the daily editing experience, including IDE and editor tooling, extensions, and code search, indexing, and navigation that stays fast as the codebase grows - Build paved roads: project scaffolding, templates, and golden-path workflows that make the right thing the easy thing - Speed up build, test, and CI - Improve our testing tooling and make sure it works well for engineers, including test orchestration, ephemeral end-to-end environments, and techniques like mutation and chaos testing that catch what ordinary tests miss - Profile build and test performance, optimize CI pipelines, parallelize and shard tests, cache aggressively, and hunt down the bottlenecks that leave engineers waiting - Integrate and optimize code review tooling and automated review - Bring AI into how we build - Evaluate, integrate, and promote AI coding agents and assistants where they deliver real leverage without sacrificing quality or maintainability - Build and curate the skills, extensions, and plugins that make those tools effective in our codebase - Measure the real impact of AI tooling so we invest where it actually pays off - Drive engineering excellence - Champion best practices and be a force multiplier for our engineering org - Track productivity metrics and feedback loops (e.g. DORA) to find where cycle time is lost and improve on it - Track code-quality signals such as coverage and mutation testing, and build the dashboards that make quality visible - Establish automation and practices that catch issues early in the development cycle YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on developer productivity, infrastructure, or platform engineering - Are passionate about developer experience and productivity; you notice when engineers are fighting tools rather than solving problems, and you can’t help but fix it - Are proficient in Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and shell and use them to build robust internal tools - You have experience with: - CI/CD systems and pipeline optimization (e.g. Github Actions, ArgoCD, Octopus, Harness) - Local development environments and reproducibility (e.g. devcontainers, Nix, Docker) - AI-assisted development tools such as coding agents and IDE assistants, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t - Test infrastructure and test orchestration, ephemeral end-to-end environments, flaky-test management, and approaches like mutation or chaos testing - Code review and developer workflow tooling, and the automation that streamlines it - Monorepo tooling, build systems, and package managers (e.g. pnpm, Nx, Turborepo, Bazel), including build caching and remote execution - Developer productivity metrics and feedback loops (e.g. DORA), and using data to drive improvements - You’ve made local development environments stable and reproducible across teams - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Solutions Integration Architect - Ariba
description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem. As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems. You Will You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization. Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations. Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs. Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets. Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments. Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations. Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio. Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right. Qualifications 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments including procurement platforms (Ariba). Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI). Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods , such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI. Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly. Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols. Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required. Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge. Comfortable working with API documentation. Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors. Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future. Strong communication skills. Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive. Experience working with product and engineering teams. Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement. Perks & Benefits At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. 📈 Start-up equity 🦷 Health Insurance 🌴 Flexible PTO 🚠 Team building events & happy hours 💻 Home office stipend 🛜 Connectivity reimbursement 🍼 Paid parental leave 💸 Pension Contributions We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Dutch speaking Support Specialist
description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between. Working closely with various global teams at Lightspeed, you will investigate, troubleshoot, test and resolve issues that our hospitality customers may be facing during service. What you’ll be doing: Working with a truly global, multi-language 24x7 team across APAC, EMEA and NOAM Flexibility on working days and shifts (weekends included) Have enthusiastic, positive and knowledgeable interactions with our Hospitality customers, partners and Lightspeed team members, maintaining Lightspeed's Gold Class standard for support via phone, chat and email. Use consistent troubleshooting techniques to quickly and efficiently identify the source of customer issues and provide a prompt and appropriate solution Work within our customer support platforms to document, track and resolve interactions Assist with the identification, reproduction and escalation of product issues and bugs to the Quality Assurance team, tracking through to resolution with each customer, partner and Lightspeed team member Advocate and promote improvements to our products and services Operating within a roster/schedule to ensure high availability of our assistance for our customers (In collaboration with your manager) What you’ll be bringing to the team: Previous customer service experience and/or technical support Strong attention to detail with an emphasis on providing an exceptional customer experience Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch & English Basic experience using common online, mobile and desktop platforms; iOS, Android, OSX, Windows Even better if you have, but not necessary: Experience interacting with customers through Phone, Email, Ticketing and Live Chat platforms Experience or knowledge of the Hospitality industry Experience supporting a SaaS product Experience supporting an iOS application Computer networking experience or interest Even better if you have, but not necessary Passion in technology; Working knowledge of Mac OS and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS; Hospitality experience; French written and verbal communication skills; We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! Please make sure to apply with a CV in English. What’s in it for you: PTO scheme 400€ annually towards Health and Wellbeing Dental cover Private healthcare Optical cover Opportunity to join a growing team, in a fast-paced, high-growth company Work with a team of incredibly talented and forward-thinking people! Work for a team that values hard work, and knows how to celebrate the wins Amazing benefits & perks, including equity for all Lightspeeders In short, an opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed family, a true Canadian tech success story. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Agents
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: An AI agent is only as useful as what it knows about your company. For many of the world's leading companies, that knowledge lives in Notion. The AI Knowledge & Capabilities team makes sure every agent working in Notion – built by Notion, by customers, or by other AI companies – finds the right answer, quickly and at a cost that makes sense. We own the systems that make this work: search, knowledge, and memory. We also own the agent harness – the tools, context, and model choices that turn a model into a working agent. We decide what to build using evals, customer feedback, and product judgment. Our work reaches users directly, and other AI teams at Notion build on it. We recently shipped Memories, so Notion AI, Custom Agents, and agents connected through MCP can learn and remember across platforms. We also shipped Auto, a model router that delivers frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Next, we're bringing memory, search, and the harness together into one system. Nobody has figured out how to package that yet – we want any company to get a great knowledge system for its agents with a click or a few questions. You will be a technical leader for the team. You'll set direction across search, knowledge, and the harness, starting hands-on with making agents better and cheaper, and help define how Notion measures AI quality. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Set technical direction for search, knowledge, and the agent harness – make the architecture calls, run design reviews, and decide what the team builds next. - Make Notion's agents better, faster, and cheaper – starting with the harness: which tools an agent can call, what context it gets, and which model handles each request. - Lead how we measure agent quality – evolve the metrics and evals that reflect real usage, and use them to choose what ships. - Turn company data into answers agents can use – build agentic search and memory that give every agent the context it needs, at the right latency and cost. - Work closely with research – partner with Notion's model research team on evals, model choice, and models trained for agentic work, and get what works into production. You'll also work with search platform and AI product teams on work that spans teams. - Grow the team – mentor engineers, review designs, and develop the next tech leads. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Production applied AI: You've shipped and iterated on production LLM or agent systems used by real users. You owned how their quality was measured, and you changed course based on what you found. - Quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs: You've traded quality against latency and cost in a production system, measured the result, and can explain what you gave up and why. - Technical leadership: You've owned the technical direction of a complex system, often across teams, and kept it sound as it grew. You don't wait for a roadmap – you find the problems worth solving, make the case for them, and go deep on the hardest ones yourself. - Product sense: You've shipped quality improvements users noticed, and you've shaped new products from scratch – from the data model to what users see. title: Senior Leadership & AI Enablement Consultant (w/d/m)
description: Führungskräfte sollen entscheiden, wo AI in ihrem Bereich hilft. Viele können nicht einschätzen, ob ein Prozess RPA, generative AI oder einen Agenten braucht und ob die Daten reichen. Mit dir lernen sie das an einem eigenen Use Case, den sie über mehrere Wochen bearbeiten. WE BUILD AI ist eine AI-Beratung mit eigenem Engineering in Köln. Wir sind rund zehn Leute und arbeiten mit Mittelstand und Konzernen. Uns geht es um AI, die in Prozessen und in der Wertschöpfung wirkt. Deine Rolle Gemeinsam mit einer Partnerberatung für Führung und Change bauen wir gerade ein Programm für Führungskräfte im Konzernumfeld auf. Es verbindet Präsenzblöcke, eine Praxisphase am eigenen Use Case und Coaching über mehrere Wochen. Du leitest Präsenzblöcke allein und deckst dabei Führung, Technologie, Prozesse und Daten ab, immer aus Sicht der Führungskraft. Dafür bist du etwa einmal im Monat für zwei Tage vor Ort, in NRW und Norddeutschland. Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du in unserem Trainingsbereich, den wir gerade ausbauen. Dort gibst du Trainings und Workshops bei weiteren Kund:innen und sammelst Use Cases für unsere Discovery Sprints. Deine Arbeit wirkt, wenn Use Cases nach dem Training weiterlaufen und Projekte daraus entstehen. Aufgaben Du leitest Präsenzblöcke von zwei Tagen allein und führst die Gruppe von der eigenen Rolle bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage. Technologie erklärst du so, dass Führungskräfte einordnen können, was RPA, klassische AI, generative AI und Agents leisten. Mit Design Thinking und Service Design führst du die Teilnehmenden vom Pain Point zum priorisierten Use Case. In der Praxisphase coachst du die Gruppe remote und gibst Feedback auf Problemdefinition, Datenlage und erste Lösungsideen. Übergaben und Trainingsdesign stimmst du eng mit den Trainer:innen der Partnerberatung ab. Die Inhalte prüfst du jedes Quartal und passt Beispiele und Übungen an neue Entwicklungen an. Außerhalb des Programms gibst du Trainings und Workshops und bringst vielversprechende Use Cases in Discovery Sprints. Formate, Methoden und Vorlagen für unseren Trainingsbereich baust du mit auf. Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrere Jahre Trainings oder Workshops für Führungskräfte gegeben, gern auch mehrtägige Formate. Eine Gruppe aus Abteilungs- und Bereichsleitungen hältst du zwei Tage allein bei der Sache, auch bei kritischen Rückfragen. AI nutzt du selbst jeden Tag. Wie Sprachmodelle und Agents funktionieren und wo ihre Grenzen liegen, kannst du einfach erklären. Design Thinking, Service Design oder Prozessanalyse hast du in echten Projekten eingesetzt. Bei Daten bleibst du skeptisch und erkennst, wann ein Dashboard eine Entscheidung trägt. Erfahrung mit großen Organisationen hilft, etwa mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und AI Act. Idealerweise kommst du aus Beratung, Learning & Development, Organisationsentwicklung oder Change Management. Reisen gehört für dich dazu, und Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher. Was wir bieten Remote-Arbeit mit regelmäßigen Teamtagen in unserem Büro in Köln-Ehrenfeld, wo Getränke, Snacks und Bürohunde warten. Ein Trainingsbereich, der gerade entsteht und den du von Anfang an mitgestaltest. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Mentoring und ehrliches Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket. Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive. Teamevents und gemeinsame Workations. So läuft die Bewerbung Kennenlern-Call mit Mounir und Frederic, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns und schauen, ob die Grundlage stimmt. Probesequenz im Call, 45 bis 60 Minuten. Du bereitest eine Trainingseinheit für Führungskräfte vor und führst sie mit uns durch. Kennenlernen vor Ort in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblicken in unsere Projekte und Sparring mit dem Team. And beyond. ⭐️ The Privacy & Product Legal Counsel role ⭐️ We're at a pivotal moment in our journey, scaling across multiple countries while handling some of our members' most sensitive data and building increasingly sophisticated health products that require thoughtful privacy-by-design approaches. As we mature, the complexity and impact of privacy decisions grow exponentially, making this role critical to our continued success. That is where you come in. You'll work at the intersection of privacy, AI, health, product, and innovation, contributing to Alan's position on opportunities and risks as early as the strategy and roadmapping stage. With tens of features or completely new services that can involve novel uses of health data being discussed or launched every couple of months, you'll need to find radical shortcuts and paint the bigger picture behind individual ideas. We also like to explore how AI and automation can improve legal work, from drafting and research to repetitive tasks. Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Health professionals, Operations, Design and Data teams on a daily basis. Beyond: you become a trusted reference on privacy and product law at Alan, for Product teams and, over time, in conversations with regulators. ⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️ Strong GDPR expertise in France, and ideally in other jurisdictions such as Belgium, Spain or Canada and the ability to work on privacy topics from day one. Clear written communication, and the ability to turn complex legal questions into simple options and recommendations for non‑lawyers. A hands‑on, pragmatic approach to risk: you enjoy helping teams find a way forward. Curiosity about AI and automation, and a desire to explore how they can improve legal work. title: Clinical Lead, Women's Health
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 💜 The role Women's bodies are different, yet medicine still treats them the same. Women get diagnosed about 4 years later than men on average across 700+ types of disease. In France, 51% of women say a health professional has played down their symptoms at least once. We want to change that. We are building the health system women never had : one that listens to women, anticipates their needs at every stage of life instead of waiting for problems to appear, and gives them care they can trust. To do this, we combine the latest evidence, digital tools, AI and carefully selected health professionals with our strength as an insurer. We are looking for a doctor who wants to do medicine differently : to build products that thousands of women use and that address their needs; to move care towards prevention; and to work every day with people who think differently, such as product managers, designers, engineers and marketers. As our Clinical Lead for Women's Health, you make this clinically credible and effective. You own the clinical choices, and you are an essential and active contributor in the product team. A few things to know before you apply This is a clinical role inside a product team, at an early stage. You own the clinical choices and you build the product with project builder, engineers, designers, ... A good product combines many factors, and the clinical side is one of them. There is a lot to build, to test and to change, and not everything is proven yet. For example, we measure how much our services are used much better than the health outcomes they achieve: building that measurement, honestly, is part of the job. You work outside the usual medical world. Most of your colleagues are not health professionals. You will confront perspectives, explain clinical constraints in simple words, listen to product and business constraints, and find solutions together. Decisions are discussed and made as a team. It takes real time. We prefer 80% or more; at least 60% is possible. What you will do You will be the clinical lead of our Women's Health offer, and you will help turn it into a product that women use and trust. Build the product with the team. Work closely with product managers, designers and engineers, and bring the clinical view early, when it shapes decisions, not at the end. With AI tools, you can also build simple things yourself, without knowing how to code. Own the clinical choices. Define our clinical positions based on evidence, design protocols and care pathways, and hold a few clear, explained red lines. When something doesn't work, you help find a safe and relevant alternative. Make our AI safe and accurate on women's health. Work with the product team on how Mo, our AI-powered health companion, handles women's health topics, and help evaluate and improve it. Show the value for women. Help define how we measure the impact on women's health, using evidence-based tools and value-based healthcare principles. Work with our Clinic team. Work hand in hand with Alan's doctors, midwives and other health professionals: help train and support them, and be the person they turn to for difficult cases. Feed and endorse our medical communication. Make sure what we say about women's health is accurate and evidence-based, and help explain it in simple words. Over time, you may represent Alan on these topics. What success looks like in 6 months Product: you are a core member of the product team, and the first member journeys reflect your clinical input from the start. Protocols in use: the clinical protocols and care pathways of our first women's health program are validated and applied by the Clinic team. Clinic team: midwives and doctors on the program are trained on the protocols, clinical staffing is under way, and you supervise complex cases. Health outcomes: the program's health outcomes are defined and tracked. AI quality: you have helped us make sure our AI handles women's health safely and accurately. What this role is not Not a medical advisor or reviewer who comes in at the end, nor the person who decides alone. Not the person who runs all the consultations: our midwives and doctors do that, and you design, pilot and supervise. Not an expert on every topic: you bring in other health professionals when needed. A dynamic, international community of health professionals You don't work alone. You join Alan's health professionals community : a large network of doctors, midwives, psychologists and other clinicians in France, Spain, Belgium and Canada, and a small core team of Alaners, other clinical leads working on different health programs or services. It is a community with high standards, direct and caring feedback, and a lot of room to shape things. Beyond Women's Health, you will: Share your practice and learn from others through case reviews and community sessions; Help set common standards across programs; Help welcome, train and mentor new health professionals joining Alan; Help other teams at Alan understand key health concepts, such as evidence-based care; Over time, contribute to other health topics beyond Women's Health. 👀 Is it you we're looking for? Must-haves You are a gynecologist (OB-GYN) or a GP with solid training in women's health , for example a university diploma (DU or DIU) in gynecology, or several years of regular gynecological follow-up in your practice. You can come from private practice, a hospital, a clinic or a health tech company. At least 5 years of post-residency experience , with solid clinical judgment and evidence-based prescribing. Clinical experience across several areas of women's health , for example contraception, fertility, endometriosis, menopause or hormone treatments. An open, pragmatic mindset: you enjoy working with non-medical teams, you make trade-offs when they are legitimate while defending evidence-based rigor, and you are curious about what AI and digital tools change in medicine. Outcomes thinking: you care about the results that matter to patients compared with what care costs (value-based healthcare), and about prevention, not only treatment. A great understanding of the French healthcare system . Fluency in both French and English . Nice-to-haves Experience training or supervising other health professionals is a plus, and a collaborative approach with midwives, dietitians, therapists, … Experience in digital health, a start-up, a healthcare project or teleconsultation . Experience writing or contributing to a clinical protocol or guideline . 🤝 How we work Contract: you join Alan as an employee, ideally at 80% or more, and at least 60%. You can keep some clinical practice outside Alan. Team: you are part of the Women's Health product team and of Alan's health professionals community. Location: our headquarters are in Paris. You can be based abroad, as long as you speak French fluently and know the French healthcare system well. Remote work: we offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration. 🔄 What to expect from our recruitment process Application Review: we read your CV and application. Screening interview (45 to 60 minutes): your path, your motivation for this role, and practical points such as your availability. Technical interview: a short written case at home (60 to 90 minutes), including a situation where clinical and product needs conflict, then a live discussion of your answers. Alaner Fit interview: a conversation about how we work at Alan and whether it suits you. Alan Day: an on-site day where you prepare concrete use cases, present them to a panel and meet the people you would work with. Reference calls , including at least one with a non-medical colleague you have worked with. Important note: we hire people, not roles. ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Over 3 years of experience guiding</span> backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Ability to hire and grow</span> backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Technical credibility</span> to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, title: Knowledge Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States. The Knowledge Engineer will play a pivotal role in building the knowledge infrastructure and AI-powered systems that support business operations and customer experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment. Accountabilities: Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Consolidate and organize knowledge from multiple platforms, including Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, HubSpot, Zendesk, Highspot, and Slack, ensuring that each source has clear ownership and scheduled review dates. Collaborate with Data and Business Insights teams to make existing business data AI-ready by providing curated, read-only Snowflake views and standardized metric definitions that align with established reporting systems. Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows for business functions such as customer support ticket triage, renewal research, accounts payable processing, and software reviews. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Create automated pipelines that identify changes in documentation, business systems, and operational processes, ensuring that knowledge repositories, AI agents, and workflows remain accurate and up to date. Structure and optimize information for AI retrieval through taxonomy development, metadata management, content chunking, tagging, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Establish evaluation frameworks and quality assurance processes to measure AI agent accuracy, detect outdated or conflicting information, and minimize hallucinations before and after deployment. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Document technical architecture, workflows, integration standards, and operational processes while staying informed about emerging AI technologies and industry best practices. Monitor AI usage, operational costs, adoption, and feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve answer quality, and prioritize future enhancements. Partner with subject-matter experts across Support, Customer Success, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Product, and Engineering to capture institutional knowledge, map business processes, and establish content ownership. Collaborate with training teams, Product Marketing, and departmental AI champions to transform product documentation, customer support resources, and training materials into AI-accessible knowledge for internal teams and external customers. Integrate AI-powered tools into employee and customer training programs to improve knowledge sharing, self-service capabilities, and operational efficiency. At least 5 years of experience in knowledge engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or technical knowledge management. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time. Benefits: Full-time remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to a company-wide AI transformation and help establish the foundations of an AI-first operating model. High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>This position is 100% remote and will be based in Australia (Sydney/Melbourne).</p> <h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative to join our growing Go To Market team. As a BDR at GitLab, you will lead the initial outreach to targeted Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts in Australia, working in conjunction with our Field and Digital Marketing teams. We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab, and we will provide you with the necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Manage inbound lead flow and execute outbound prospecting initiatives.</li> <li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations in target accounts.</li> <li>Meet or exceed BDR sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) volume targets.</li> <li>Collaborate with and leverage teammates to develop targeted lists, call strategies, and messaging to drive opportunities.</li> <li>Use business and industry knowledge to research accounts, identify key players, generate interest, identify compelling events, and develop accounts.</li> <li>Execute a variety of touches (call, email, social, etc.) on all leads in your assigned territory using Outreach.io.</li> <li>Manage, track, and report on all activities and results using Salesforce.</li> <li>Participate in documenting all processes in the GitLab handbook and update as needed with your Sales Development Manager.</li> <li>Collaborate with Field and Corporate Marketing to drive attendance at regional marketing events.</li> <li>Attend field marketing events to engage with participants, identify opportunities, and schedule meetings.</li> <li>Act as a mentor for new BDR hires in helping them navigate their key accounts.</li> <li>Collaborate with Digital Marketing to develop targeted marketing tactics against your assigned target accounts.</li> <li>Share innovative ideas and collaborate with the team to continuously refine BDR strategies and drive measurable results.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional proficiency in English. Proficiency in other Asian languages is a plus.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, and strong writing skills.</li> <li>A self-starter with a track record of successful, credible achievements.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Experience in developing Enterprise and Mid-Market business in Australia </li> <li>Demonstrated persistence in meeting or exceeding targets through consistent follow-up, effective objection handling, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Demonstrated interest in GitLab and the DevOps space, such as staying current on GitLab releases or industry trends.</li> <li>Proficient in using Salesforce (incl. Salesforce reporting) and LinkedIn. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Strategy and sourcing - Map the markets and targets that matter to Supabase's roadmap, and keep the map current. - Decide build vs buy each quarter for key product areas, together with Product and Engineering. - Build relationships with founders early, and convert the ones we want. Building the function - Build automation for target discovery, relationship tracking, and diligence. - Build the Supabase M&A muscle, and improve it after every deal. - Note: Supabase is here to scale revenue, not headcount. You should be as comfortable as a IC as a cross functional leader, and want to build the system, not the org chart. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 7+ years of experience in M&A - Are comfortable in highly technical domains. - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. title: Customer Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer Manager</strong></h3> <p>As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets  you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. The role requires someone with strong leadership, interpersonal, and business acumen to work with Sales to grow our account base. The SE Manager will manage a team of SEs that are geographically distributed within the US and Mexico, covering all of the countries that make up LATAM for Cloudflare.  The SE team partners with the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Public Sector LATAM Sales teams that are also geographically distributed in the US and Mexico, as well as Customer Success and is responsible for providing the value of Cloudflare products to customers and prospects</p> <h3><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, experience and goals</strong></h3> <p>Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: financial consulting, engineering, software development, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.</p> <p>Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture.</p> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems or another related field or its equivalent.</li> <li>3+ years of experience with internet technologies / protocols and / or cloud technologies</li> <li>Minimum 1 year of team lead/team management experience</li> <li>Experience managing opportunity sales cycles and identifying technical proof activities </li> <li>Demonstrated operations and organization skills implementation and driving best practices with cross functional organizations.</li> <li>Strong organizational and analytical skills.</li> <li>Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives.</li> <li>Successful track record of working and influencing matrixed organizations.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present technical and business related subjects to all audiences.</li> <li>Demonstrated problem solving skills, drive for results, interpersonal savvy, and customer focus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

<div><strong>What you'll bring</strong></div> <ul> <li>Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.</li> <li>An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.</li> <li>Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.</li> <li>Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.</li> <li>Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>About the team</strong><br>Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data. As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most. The Role We are looking for a Finance Controller to own DTACT’s finance function end-to-end as we continue to scale internationally. Reporting into the COO, you’ll take full ownership of accounting, collections, financial analytics, budgeting, and compliance (including our Dutch statutory obligations) — acting as the single point of accountability for finance in the business today. This is a hands-on, mid-level role: you’ll be expected to run the entire finance function largely on your own in the near term, while also bringing the leadership mindset and ambition to grow the function — and your own role — as DTACT expands. What you'll do Own end-to-end accounting operations — AP/AR, general ledger, and month end/year-end close — ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting. Manage the full collections process: invoicing, aging follow-up, and cash flow forecasting. Build and maintain finance analytics (dashboards, reports) that give leadership clear, real-time visibility into company performance. Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan. Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors. Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows. What you'll bring 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment. Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll. Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team. Strong analytical skills and financial modeling ability; comfortable turning data into clear, actionable insights. Leadership potential and genuine ambition to grow into a finance leadership role as the team and company scale. A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically. Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch. What's in for you Competitive compensation and equity participation , including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success. Remote-first flexibility , with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs. A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication , empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams. Generous time off , including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Home office support , including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace. An international and diverse team , where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats. We believe diverse teams build better solutions. DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply. Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license.
