Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Journey Architect on GitLab's Digital Customer Outcomes team, you'll design journeys that turn meaningful customer actions into retention, consumption and revenue outcomes. You'll own journey design and service blueprints for assigned customer cohorts, products or coverage models, leading cross-functional work from design through launch. Digital Orchestration builds and runs the journeys day to day; you'll remain accountable for their outcomes and ongoing improvement. You'll add design capacity to help priority journeys, including artificial intelligence (AI) and consumption journeys, launch in fiscal year 2028 (FY28).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design journeys backward from business outcomes to meaningful customer actions, audiences and engagement tactics. Map each cohort's intended path, timing, signals that customers need help and interventions to get them back on track.</li> <li value="2">Decide which steps are self-serve, AI-assisted or human-led, and define the handoffs between them. Design across in-product guidance, email, events and community, choosing the right channel for each moment.</li> <li value="3">Build service blueprints with Customer Experience (CX) Operations, documenting the people, systems, data, content and handoffs behind each touchpoint. Give every step a trigger, a response, an owner and a metric.</li> <li value="4">Write journey specifications covering steps, triggers, audiences, channels, content, handoffs and metrics. Set build plans, coordinate partner teams and clear dependencies to launch on time and to specification.</li> <li value="5">Specify the content and self-service resources each step needs, and work with content teams to create and govern them. Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on audience, sequencing and delivery so customers experience one coordinated journey.</li> <li value="6">Hand live journeys to Digital Orchestration to run, remain accountable for their outcomes and build in regular optimization cycles with the Digital Outcomes team's Data/Insights partner.</li> <li value="7">Measure journey coverage, step conversion, lift against comparison groups, meaningful actions, recovery after interventions, time to value and influence on retention. Track partner adoption of the shared journeys and blueprints.</li> <li value="8">Apply the framework and standards set by the Lead Journey Architect, and help improve them based on what your journeys teach the team.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in customer journey design, service design or digital customer success.</li> <li value="2">A track record of turning journey designs into launched programs with measurable outcomes.</li> <li value="3">Hands-on experience building service blueprints and designing handoffs between digital and human teams.</li> <li value="4">Working knowledge of journey orchestration, in-app guidance and marketing automation platforms.</li> <li value="5">Comfort defining customer signals and success metrics, and interpreting funnel conversion and test results.</li> <li value="6">Experience leading cross-functional work through launch without direct authority.</li> <li value="7">Experience in business-to-business software as a service is helpful, as is domain knowledge of development and operations (DevOps) or development, security and operations (DevSecOps).</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Digital Customer Outcomes team brings digital experiences and human support together around customer outcomes. You'll work day to day with the Lead Journey Architect, Digital Orchestration and the Digital Outcomes team's Data/Insights partner, alongside CX Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Engineering and Operations, Content, Product, CX Engineering, Customer Success, Renewals and CX Services. title: Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover
description: About Volta Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds. About The Role Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams. You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live. Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it. What You Will Be Doing Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service. Build and lead the global Commissioning and Handover team, covering electrical, mechanical and CDU commissioning standards, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence. Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations. Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service. Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through to handover. Set the facilities readiness and operational readiness standards and governance, so each facility is ready for operations and the operations team is ready to run it. Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training. Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site. Report commissioning progress and risk across sites, and feed lessons learned back into the standards and the reference design. What You Bring Experience leading commissioning of hyperscale data centres, including electrical, mechanical and liquid cooling systems. Data centre experience is essential. A track record owning commissioning and handover across multiple concurrent sites at this level, and the ability to run it from day one. Deep knowledge of commissioning levels, integrated systems testing and the turn-up sequence for high density GPU environments. Experience with CDU and liquid cooling commissioning and handover into operations. Experience setting readiness governance and handing live facilities over to operations teams. Experience building and leading commissioning teams and managing commissioning agents and contractors. Understanding of physical and systems security requirements in mission critical facilities. Willingness to travel to sites across Europe and North America. REQ-263 What We Offer At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of. As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do. Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success Retirement/pension contributions Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits Generous number of vacation days each year Additional Information Background Checks All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law. Equal Opportunity Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. Accessibility Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at Candidate Privacy Notice By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice. Note to Recruitment Agencies Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. </p> <p>Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums  </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite</li> <li>Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers</li> <li>Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews</li> <li>Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies</li> <li>Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting</li> <li>Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business</li> <li>Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial</li> <li>Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends</li> <li>Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions</li> <li>Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus</li> <li>Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes</li> <li>Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role </li> <li>A take-home task</li> <li>Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Staff Product Engineer ( SaaS / Remote )
description: Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? The Mission: Publitas lets people, and increasingly agents, create, host and distribute digital flyers and catalogues for retail brands. Our customers include ALDI, IKEA, Carrefour, Metro and Decathlon. Right now we’re building a fully automatic, agentic workflow that generates a whole catalogue from a brand guide and a list of products. As a Staff Product Engineer, you’ll build this product hands-on, taking open-ended problems to working software in whatever part of the stack the problem needs. You’ll join a team of senior engineers who are put on our hardest problems, some of which cut across teams. Our customer base is large (not Google scale, but big), so what you ship gets used, and it comes with real technical challenges. Our core stack is Ruby on Rails on the backend and JavaScript with React on the frontend, with services around it in JavaScript, TypeScript and Python. This is a staff-level role, and you’ll have a lot of influence in a mid-sized company with very little red tape. This role is for you if You've built several complete products and you'd enjoy showing them to us. You like open-ended problems, and you'd rather work out what to build than be handed a spec. You enjoy problems that are hard to think through, and you can point to one you cracked. You get excited about the end result, not just the code. AI has changed what you dare to build: you ship faster, and you take on projects you’d never have started alone. You want real influence in a mid-sized company with a large customer base and very little red tape. It's probably not for you if You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack. You want a detailed spec or a clear list of tasks before you start. You're still trying AI out rather than building with it every day. Where and when you work The role is fully remote, and most of the stakeholders and peers work Central European hours. Nobody sets your schedule, but we'd like around six hours of overlap with the team on a normal day. In practice that works best if you live within about two hours of CET. Show us what you've built When you apply, point us to things you've made. Complete, working applications say the most, but libraries and tools are welcome too. We'd love to hear how you built them. What We Offer You to Win Transparent Compensation : A competitive salary (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression. True Remote Autonomy : No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business. Global Team Retreats : Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person. Modern Sales Stack & Gear : A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home. Personal Growth Budget : A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books. Time Off : 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays. At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. You’ll partner directly with senior executives to identify, engage, assess, and hire leaders, bringing market intelligence and a research-driven approach to complex, often confidential searches. Alongside owning searches end to end, you’ll help shape the strategies, frameworks, and practices that strengthen executive recruiting at GitLab, balancing search rigor with the agility of a fast-moving technology organization.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Lead VP-level and other senior leadership searches end to end, from search strategy and market mapping through assessment, selection, and closing.</li> <li>Advise C-suite executives and senior technical leaders on hiring decisions, challenge assumptions, and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.</li> <li>Develop talent strategies using market mapping, competitive intelligence, creative sourcing, and recruiting data to guide each search.</li> <li>Build relationships with passive executive talent, understand their motivations, and connect opportunities to GitLab’s mission, technical vision, and business priorities.</li> <li>Partner with hiring leaders to define success profiles, assess executive capabilities and business impact, and guide evidence-based hiring decisions.</li> <li>Own executive candidate relationships and deliver a high-touch experience through compensation discussions, competing opportunities, and negotiations.</li> <li>Manage multiple confidential, business-critical searches with discretion, balancing urgency, quality, stakeholder alignment, and candidate experience.</li> <li>Collaborate with Talent Acquisition leadership and executive recruiting peers to improve search frameworks, assessment practices, reporting, and tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience independently leading VP-level and senior executive searches through successful hires in an executive search firm, an in-house executive recruiting function, or both.</li> <li>Executive recruiting experience across technical functions such as Engineering, Product, Security, Data, or Infrastructure, with the technical fluency and curiosity to learn new domains.</li> <li>The ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, influence senior stakeholders, and provide candid, evidence-based guidance on hiring decisions.</li> <li>Skills in talent research, market mapping, creative sourcing, leadership assessment, and engaging and closing passive executive talent.</li> <li>Business judgment, communication, and negotiation skills to navigate sensitive searches, complex compensation discussions, and competing executive priorities.</li> <li>Experience developing or improving executive search methodologies, frameworks, and processes while maintaining speed and flexibility.</li> <li>A hands-on approach to managing multiple high-priority searches independently and working through ambiguity.</li> <li>Experience in high-growth technology or enterprise software organizations, global executive searches, and distributed organizations is helpful.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Guided by GitLab’s operating principles, including Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, we take ownership, move with urgency and rigor, and focus on hiring outcomes that matter to our internal customers. We share learnings and create reusable resources to continually improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Business teams.</p> <p>I changed the department lists in the overview and the “What you’ll bring” section, added “senior technical leaders” to the C-suite advising bullet, and added “technical vision” to the passive talent bullet. title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Applied AI Engineer</strong> at GitLab, you'll design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions for GitLab's own teams. You'll join Enterprise AI in the CIO organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI. This is a hands-on senior engineering role: you'll write production code and work directly with internal business partners to solve complex problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.</p> <p>Building fast matters, but it's not enough on its own. This role starts with understanding the real problem: mapping how work moves across teams, tools, and handoffs, identifying the true constraint, and validating whether AI is the right solution before you begin development. From there, you'll take ownership from discovery through deployment, combining strong engineering skills with systems thinking and business understanding.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span GitLab's own Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams, where you'll embed AI solutions into the systems and workflows they use every day. This role offers the opportunity to shape how GitLab team members work, improve flow across the organization, and help advance our mission in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Diagnose business problems before building solutions. Map workflows, identify constraints, and confirm whether AI is the right intervention. Be prepared to say "this doesn't need AI" when that's the honest answer.</li> <li>Own AI initiatives end-to-end, from stakeholder discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Improve organizational flow by building solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Measure success using flow metrics alongside adoption and ROI.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into GitLab's internal business systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.</li> <li>Partner closely with stakeholders across functions to understand the real constraints. Ask the right questions, bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, and align on outcomes before jumping to solutions.</li> <li>Define and track success through business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to technical direction by evaluating tools, documenting patterns, and creating reusable foundations that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart - </strong>Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energized by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> <li><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - </strong>You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.</li> <li><strong>AI & LLM Technical Depth - </strong>Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Deep, practical experience with modern AI technologies, specifically:</li> <li><strong>Prompt engineering as a core discipline: </strong>designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs: understanding when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to make principled decisions about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns:</strong> tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem: hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and the judgment to know which to reach for and when.</li> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness - </strong>You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defenses, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Systems Thinking & Diagnostic Rigor - </strong>The ability to look at a complex process and see the constraint. Comfortable mapping how work flows end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks, and tracing problems to root causes before proposing solutions. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?"Business System Expertise - Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but to understand what they do, how they fit together, and be willing to build with and across them. A strong understanding of enterprise data models and workflows is essential.</li> <li><strong>Broad Functional Understanding- </strong>Ability to have meaningful conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains and quickly understand their unique needs.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Ownership - </strong>Track record of owning complex initiatives from discovery through delivery. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving to measurable outcomes independently.</li> <li><strong>Product Mindset - </strong>Ability to scope MVPs, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualifications</p> <ul> <li>Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows</li> <li>Background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or other stakeholder-facing technical roles, combining strong engineering skills with stakeholder engagement, solution design, and root cause analysis. Experience personally building and shipping production-quality solutions is especially relevant.</li> <li>Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking</li> <li>Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development</li> <li>Previous startup or high-growth company experience</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading technical projects with junior engineers</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You will join the <strong>Enterprise Technology & AI</strong> team in the CIO organization. We build and improve the internal systems and workflows that help GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and do their best work.</p> <p>We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's operating principles of Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, built on a Culture of Excellence.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Treasury Product Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/UK Remote | 💰 £56,100 - 68,000 (depending on your experience) + Incentive Award tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Treasury product control analyst to join our Financial operations & control team. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant looking for a first-time move from practice to industry and/or who has an understanding of Treasury products in the context of a banking environment. This understanding includes but is not exhaustive to Treasury investment securities, derivative instruments (interest rate swaps and FX forwards), hedge accounting and financial reporting.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges coming up like continued expansion into the European Union, growing our customer base, keep growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. This all leads to exciting Treasury activity to support this growth whilst managing risk. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Head of Treasury Product Control. </p> <p><strong>🔑  You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working very closely with our Treasury front office, treasury operations and financial control teams as we continue to build our treasury product control capabilities in Finance.</li> <li>Taking ownership of the end-to-end control processes on Treasury products. This includes:</li> <ul> <li>Independent trade confirmation for all Treasury deals booked in our Treasury Management System (TMS)</li> <li>Daily collateral management for our derivative and REPO portfolios </li> <li>Daily profit and loss reporting on Treasury income to CFO/Treasuer</li> <li>Valuation controls around Treasury financial instrument pricing</li> </ul> <li>Managing Treasury month-end processes, including derivatives and hedge accounting. </li> <li>Maintaining existing and developing new treasury related internal controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process, working with 2LoD and 3LoD along the way.</li> <li>Supporting our year end processes, preparing Treasury related disclosures, dealing with external audit queries and ad hoc assistance on non-Treasury related aspects of the cycle. </li> <li>Understanding the Treasury business and their products to write insightful management commentary on results.</li> <li>Reviewing new Treasury products, assessing and determining the accounting treatment before implementing the GL configuration mapping in our TMS.</li> <li>Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of this role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.</li> <li>Learning SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Ad hoc support on non-Treasury related initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you..</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant and have knowledge and/or understanding of Treasury products in a banking context.</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail and a thirst to learn, which sees you develop into the subject matter for all things Treasury.</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key internal controls.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s confirming trade accuracy or pulling together complex disclosures in a simplified way for derivatives in our annual report.</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus).</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>💰 </strong>£56,100 - £68,000 (depending on experience) + Incentive Award tied to your performance. </li> <li><strong>📍</strong>This role can be based in our London or Cardiff offices. title: Senior IT Product Manager, Salesforce CRM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An Overview about the Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Lead-to-Opportunity (L2O) domain within our Salesforce and GTM technology ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of marketing operations, sales process, and technology owning the roadmap for how leads are captured, scored, routed, and converted into pipeline, and how our broader GTM tech stack supports that motion.</p> <p>This is a foundational hire one of the first product managers on a team actively transforming from a reactive BSA model into a proactive, roadmap-driven product organization. You'll be both an individual contributor driving your own domain and a mentor helping BSAs grow into product manager roles. You'll have direct influence over how we shape the team's future operating model.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Product Roadmap Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for the Lead-to-Opportunity domain covering lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, conversion, opportunity and the broader GTM technology stack integrated with Salesforce</li> <li>Translate business strategy from Marketing, Sales Development, RevOps, and GTM leadership into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics</li> <li>Define the domain's strategic priorities each quarter and half, balancing net-new capability delivery, stabilization, and technical debt reduction with transparent trade-off frameworks</li> <li>Drive quarterly planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and BSAs to align capacity with roadmap commitments</li> <li>Own domain-level documentation: process maps, current-vs-future state lead lifecycle flows, and decision logs that keep stakeholders and the team aligned on scope and ownership</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements Translation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary product voice for all L2O and GTM Systems initiatives, partnering closely with Marketing, Marketing Operations, SDR/BDR leadership, Sales, and RevOps</li> <li>Lead discovery, requirements workshops, and business process design sessions translating complex GTM and marketing operations requirements into actionable system specifications</li> <li>Own the decision layer between "what the business needs" and "what engineering builds," resolving ambiguity with structured frameworks and documented decisions</li> <li>Run structured stakeholder alignment sessions to surface trade-offs, build consensus, and drive open decisions to closure rather than letting them linger</li> <li>Represent the domain in cross-team planning and leadership reviews able to explain technical constraints to business stakeholders and business context to engineers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Mentorship & Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a product craft mentor and senior thought partner for the BSA team, actively upskilling analysts in product thinking, requirements structuring, acceptance criteria definition, and roadmap communication</li> <li>Model and codify what "good" looks like reusable templates, rituals (backlog grooming, roadmap reviews), and a rubric BSAs can grow against</li> <li>Give BSAs increasing ownership over pieces of the roadmap as they develop, with regular feedback and structured check-ins</li> <li>Partner with leadership to evolve the team's operating model from project-execution-focused to product-thinking-led, raising the bar for how EntApps delivers business value</li> </ul> <p><strong>Program Strategy & Delivery Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead initiatives end-to-end: discovery, requirements, prioritization, solution design review, UAT, launch, and post-launch measurement</li> <li>Write and maintain clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and lead-flow and data-flow diagrams that engineering and admins can build against without ambiguity</li> <li>Manage a healthy, well-groomed backlog intake requests from Marketing and Sales Development, triage by impact and effort, and defend prioritization decisions to stakeholders</li> <li>Define success metrics per initiative (lead response time, routing accuracy, lead-to-opportunity conversion rate, data quality, SDR/BDR adoption) and report on outcomes, not just delivery</li> <li>Identify and de-risk dependencies across adjacent domains campaign operations, data enrichment vendors, opportunity handoff to sales before they block delivery</li> <li>Own UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with BSAs, ensuring system changes meet business requirements before production release</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Architecture Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers on Salesforce and MarTech integration design marketing automation platform to Salesforce sync, data enrichment pipelines, lead scoring and routing engines, ensuring choices hold up to governance, scale, and future roadmap needs</li> <li>Bring informed opinions on GTM platform architecture trade-offs based on deep domain knowledge</li> <li>Stay current on platform roadmaps for Salesforce Sales Cloud and connected MarTech tools, identifying opportunities to leverage native capabilities before custom builds</li> <li>Maintain domain-level R&R clarity, who owns what across US/India technical managers, BSAs, and adjacent pods and update as team and scope evolve</li> <li>Ability to engage deeply with engineering and architecture teams on API design, data modeling, and integration patterns.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in Salesforce product management, business systems analysis with demonstrated growth into product ownership</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of Lead-to-Opportunity processes; lead capture, scoring, routing, and conversion and how they connect marketing execution to sales pipeline</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with the GTM technology stack: Salesforce Sales Cloud plus marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot), lead scoring and routing tools, and data enrichment or intent providers</li> <li>Good Understanding of quoting process </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders</li> <li>Proven experience leading initiatives end-to-end with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, especially across Marketing and Sales</li> <li>Sufficient technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering on API design, data model decisions, and integration trade-offs — without needing to write code</li> <li>Experience mentoring or upskilling analysts and BSAs, you enjoy developing people, not just managing tickets</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication; able to represent technical trade-offs to non-technical executives and translate business asks into clear technical requirements</li> <li>Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving structure where none exists</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development workflows, data governance and compliance for lead data, or prior people-management experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>You'll be one of the first product managers on a team actively transforming from a reactive BSA function into a proactive, roadmap-driven product organization. The Lead-to-Opportunity domain sits at the top of GitLab's revenue funnel; the quality of data, routing, and conversion here affects every downstream system and every seller. Getting this right is not an IT problem; it's a revenue problem. You'll have direct influence over how we shape the team's future operating model and how the next generation of BSAs grows into product managers.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As an Intermediate Security Engineer on GitLab's Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), you will be on the frontline of protecting both GitLab.com and GitLab the company from security threats. This role operates on a compressed 4-day work schedule, with a full-time week's hours condensed into four longer working days. Shifts run either Sunday through Wednesday or Wednesday through Saturday to provide 24/7/365 security coverage. This role also supports our FedRAMP environment and requires U.S. citizenship and residency within the United States.</p> <p>Your primary focus will be detecting and responding to security incidents during your scheduled shifts. You'll work extensively with our incident response automation tools to investigate, analyze, and resolve security events. You'll also use AI to build security tooling and automation, helping to improve our detection and response capabilities.</p> <p>In this role, you'll develop expertise using our security infrastructure to monitor for threats, analyze potential incidents, and coordinate response efforts across teams. This position is ideal for someone who wants to grow their incident response skills while working within GitLab's established security framework. You'll learn to think both tactically and strategically about security, while getting hands-on experience handling real-world incidents.</p> <p>Successful Security Engineers thrive in high-pressure environments, remaining calm while following prepared runbooks and thinking critically about security challenges. In this role, you will learn to think like both an attacker and defender, developing proactive and preventative security measures to keep GitLab and its users' data safe in our ever-changing threat landscape. Through hands-on experience and mentorship, you'll develop the skills needed to anticipate security risks, respond effectively to incidents, and contribute to GitLab's robust security posture.</p> <p>Find out more about the Security Operations team and responsibilities here:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/security-operations/sirt/">Incident Response</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/security-operations/trustandsafety/">Trust and Safety</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/threat-management/red-team/#red-team-metrics">Red Team</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/security-operations/signals-engineering/">Detection Engineering<br><br></a></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Respond to and own security incidents in our 24/7 global rotation, managing them from detection through containment and recovery</li> <li>Create and maintain incident response documentation, including runbooks and standard procedures</li> <li>Contribute to post-incident analysis through RCA and lessons-learned reviews to strengthen our incident response program</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Build AI-assisted automation and tooling to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual work</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement by identifying security gaps and contributing to advanced detection and response capabilities</li> <li>Collaborate across GitLab teams to develop new security capabilities and deliver technical projects that enhance our infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated ability to learn and lead incident response processes independently</li> <li>Experience with SIEM/security logging tools</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and/or AWS)</li> <li>Experience building tools or automation with AI, and the judgment to test and verify what it produces (Python, SOAR, or other scripting is a plus)</li> <li>A passion for technical documentation</li> <li>Proactive approach to identifying and investigating security threats</li> <li>Interest in conducting forensic analysis of infected hosts</li> <li>Experience or strong desire to learn cloud-based security investigations</li> </ul> <p><em>Due to government requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Security Operations is a globally distributed team of engineers split across 3 core regions; AMER, APAC and EMEA, and is at the forefront of security events that impact both GitLab.com and GitLab. We are both reactive and proactive, leading security investigations, incident response support and response resolution, through to cyber threat analysis and detection and response engineering. Even though we’re a global team, we work together in a cross-regional manner and have automation and processes to facilitate collaboration when resolving incidents, handovers, and general collaboration for project work as well.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Product Marketing Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Competitive Salary + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a> </p> <p>We’re looking for several <strong>Product Marketing Leads </strong>to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.</p> <p>At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p>This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.</li> <li><strong>MonzOS </strong>is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.</li> <li><strong>EU </strong>is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>You and your team will…</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set strategy for multiple categories. </strong>You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.</li> <li><strong>Set the market intelligence agenda. </strong>You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.</li> <li><strong>Shape what gets built.</strong> You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning that moves the business. </strong>You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.</li> <li><strong>Own how we go to market.</strong> You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar for Product Marketing.</strong> You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You think beyond a single product.</strong> You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.</li> <li><strong>You own the hardest calls in your domain.</strong> You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.</li> <li><strong>You bring senior people with you.</strong> You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.</li> <li><strong>You're a player/coach.</strong> You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (45mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (1hour)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive Salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

As a Staff Product Manager for Planning at GitLab, you'll help answer that question and lead the team toward a clear product direction. This isn't just about improving traditional agile planning. You'll rethink how intent becomes actionable work, how that work moves through software development, and where human involvement is needed.</p> <p>You'll develop a point of view on planning's future and turn it into product decisions with engineering, design, and product leadership. That includes exploring how planning could connect work to business priorities and budgets, rather than assuming the answer is already decided. Alongside that strategic work, you'll share ownership of existing planning capabilities with another product manager.</p> <p>We're opening this role at Staff level, with flexibility to consider Principal level based on your experience and scope of impact.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define a clear direction for planning as software development shifts toward collaboration between people and artificial intelligence agents, and help the team move from open questions to concrete priorities.</li> <li>Shape how users capture intent, break it into actionable work, and determine which work can proceed autonomously and which needs human involvement.</li> <li>Evaluate whether and how planning should connect software delivery to company priorities, business objectives, and budgets.</li> <li>Share ownership of planning capabilities, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning, with a fellow product manager. Help define how that scope is divided.</li> <li>Work with engineering and design to translate product direction into a roadmap and improvements to planning workflows across GitLab.</li> <li>Communicate your recommendations clearly to senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and lead the team through changes in direction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading product strategy and execution for software development, developer tools, or planning products, with the depth to make decisions in a specialized product area.</li> <li>A strong understanding of software development and development and operations (DevOps) workflows, including how planning decisions affect downstream delivery.</li> <li>The ability to form and defend a product point of view in an uncertain, changing market, while staying open to different ideas.</li> <li>Clear communication with technical teams and senior executives, including experience challenging leadership decisions constructively and building support for a direction.</li> <li>The ability to connect a forward-looking strategy to practical product decisions and work collaboratively across product, engineering, and design.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Planning team builds the capabilities at the start of GitLab's software development workflow, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning. Decisions here affect how work moves through the rest of the platform, so the team's scope extends beyond standalone project management tools.</p> <p>You'll work alongside another product manager and partner with engineering and design across this product area. The division of product ownership is still being shaped, and you'll help define it. The hiring manager wants you to bring a different perspective, question established approaches, and challenge senior leaders constructively, with room to influence decisions beyond your immediate product scope.</p> <p>GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Switchboard is the control plane for Dedicated: it helps internal teams scale upgrades and maintenance, while giving customers a place to configure their infrastructure, understand the health of their environment, and receive critical updates.</p> <p>You'll own the product vision and roadmap, balancing technical and operational needs with a clear, useful customer experience. Dedicated is GitLab's fastest-growing deployment option, and your work will help the business support more customers efficiently. You'll have the autonomy to identify the most important problems and decide where Switchboard should go next, with support from your manager and engineering partners.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Set the vision and roadmap for Switchboard, connecting customer needs and internal operational challenges to priorities for the engineering team.</li> <li>Work with engineering and site reliability engineering teams to improve the tools used to operate Dedicated instances, including upgrades and maintenance.</li> <li>Improve the customer-facing console so customers can manage infrastructure settings, configure private networking and authentication, and understand their instance's health.</li> <li>Talk directly with customers to understand their needs, explain product decisions, and use their feedback to shape the roadmap.</li> <li>Bring a strong user experience perspective to product decisions. Work hands-on with engineering to develop and refine workflows, including when a dedicated design partner isn't available.</li> <li>Explore opportunities to improve the tooling and experience for customers migrating from self-managed GitLab to Dedicated, how we help manage incidents, and to extend Switchboard to support GitLab.com as its architecture evolves.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning a product vision and roadmap and working with engineering to deliver improvements for users.</li> <li>Technical understanding that helps you discuss infrastructure and operational tradeoffs with engineers and translate them into clear product decisions.</li> <li>A strong focus on user experience, with experience making complex technical workflows easier to understand and use.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability and interest to work directly with customers. Experience with internal tools is relevant, provided you're comfortable taking on customer-facing product work.</li> <li>The ability to work independently, make sense of an evolving problem space, and prioritize across customer experience, operational efficiency, and business needs.</li> <li>You may also bring experience with control planes, cloud management consoles, infrastructure products, internal operational tools, customer migrations, or incident management, but these aren't required. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across product management, engineering, and site reliability engineering to solve technical, operational, and user experience problems.</p> <p>At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. On GitLab.com, you'll guide growth through better customer isolation and additional cells, alongside rate limits, usage limits, and monetization. On GitLab Dedicated, you'll help scale it to hundreds of customers through automation, customer self-service, and closer alignment with GitLab's latest releases. You'll balance customer needs with operating costs and gross margin.</p> <p>This director-level role starts as an individual contributor. It's remote and open to candidates based in the United States or Canada, with no specific time zone preference.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Set the product strategy and roadmap across GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated, connecting platform capabilities to customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Drive improvements in platform reliability, scalability, and operability, including better separation between customers and expansion of GitLab.com's cell-based architecture.</li> <li>Define GitLab.com's rate limits, usage limits, and related monetization approach.</li> <li>Scale GitLab Dedicated through maintenance-window automation and other operational improvements, while controlling costs and improving gross margin.</li> <li>Expand customer self-service through Switchboard, giving customers tools to monitor, observe, and operate their Dedicated tenants.</li> <li>Guide capabilities such as customer-initiated disaster recovery and geographic redundancy, and enable earlier access to beta features on GitLab Dedicated.</li> <li>Reduce the delay between GitLab releases and their availability on Dedicated.</li> <li>Own the business side of the portfolio as well as the technical product direction, developing profit and loss (P&L) ownership for both platforms and helping establish GitLab.com as a P&L business.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading a product portfolio at director level or with comparable scope, setting direction across multiple related products rather than a single roadmap.</li> <li>Technical product experience with cloud platforms, infrastructure, or SaaS environments, including the tradeoffs involved in reliability, scalability, and operations.</li> <li>The ability to connect product decisions to commercial outcomes, including monetization, operating costs, and gross margin.</li> <li>Experience translating complex platform challenges into product priorities and working across teams to deliver them.</li> <li>The ability to lead through product direction and influence in a director-level individual contributor role.</li> </ul> <p>Direct ownership of a product P&L is particularly valuable. Experience in an organization actively adopting artificial intelligence (AI) would also be helpful.</p> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The SaaS platform portfolio brings together GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated. The work spans shared-platform growth, single-tenant operations, and the tools customers use to manage their environments.
