leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.</li> <li value="2">Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.</li> <li value="3">Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.</li> <li value="4">Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.</li> <li value="5">Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.</li> <li value="6">Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.</li> <li value="7">Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.</li> <li value="8">Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.</li> <li value="2">A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.</li> <li value="3">Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.</li> <li value="4">Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.</li> <li value="5">Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.</li> <li value="6">Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.</li> <li value="7">Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.</li> <li value="8">Executive-level communication and influence.</li> <li value="9">Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. title: Freelance Product Manager – AI for Quality & Regulatory
description: About Acodis Acodis is a Swiss software company based in Winterthur, providing AI-driven document processing for global Life Sciences companies. We help Quality and Regulatory teams move from document-centric to data-driven ways of working. The Mandate We are looking for an experienced freelance Product Manager to turn our AI platform into dedicated product solutions for two use cases. Working directly with management and our product engineering team, you will own both from discovery to market launch. Quality – Batch Record Review: AI-assisted review of executed batch records: checking completeness and correctness of entries, flagging deviations and GMP-relevant exceptions, and shortening review cycles ahead of batch disposition. Regulatory – CMC & Regulatory Submissions: Extraction and reuse of CMC data for submissions (CTD Module 3), consistency checks between source documents and submission content, and support for variations and post-approval changes. Mandate Deliverables Product definition & validation: Customer interviews, validated user workflows and value cases, and engineering-ready specifications and roadmap for both use cases. Pilot support: In our running pilots, including success criteria and a GxP-compliant validation approach. Go-to-market: Positioning, messaging, input and launch materials, together with the commercial team. Required Expertise 8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences. Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation. Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates. Nice to have: Experience with AI/LLM-based document processing, data pipelines, or platforms such as Veeva, MasterControl, Snowflake or Databricks. Mandate Details Duration & workload: 3–6 months from Jan/Feb 2027, 80–100%, extension possible. Location: Fully remote; no on-site presence in Winterthur required, but possible. Contract: Freelance (self-employed or via your own company) What We Offer A clearly scoped mandate with autonomy in how you deliver it. Direct access to management, engineering and customers, with short decision paths. The chance to shape two flagship products, with potential for a follow-on mandate. How to Apply Please upload your CV and relevant references, availability and daily rate to our recruiting platform. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description: Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier. We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth. We are looking for a senior software engineer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will: Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts. Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface. Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly. Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed. Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results. Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment. Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution. Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost. Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate. Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations. Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers. You should get in touch if: You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration. You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring. You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language. You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS. You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls. Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role. You will love this job if: You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice. You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it. You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it. You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â Professional Development : We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Reimbursement for office setup expenses Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. title: Embedded & Desktop Linux Systems Engineer - Optimisation
description: <p>Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.</p> <p>The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is a Globally remote role</span></em></p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What your day will look like</span></h2> <ul> <li>Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks</li> <li>Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms</li> <li>Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics</li> <li>Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge</li> <li>Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server</li> <li>Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.</li> </ul> <p>Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.</p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we are looking for in you</span></h2> <ul> <li>You love technology and working with brilliant people</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar </li> <li>You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)</li> <li>You have experience working with open source communities and licences</li> <li>You have experience working with C, C++</li> <li>You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">Additional skills that you might also bring</span></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with graphics stacks</li> <li>Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST</li> <li>Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments</li> <li>Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience</li> <li>IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services</li> <li>Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we offer you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">About Canonical</span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</span></p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote </span></p>

title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
description: Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . About the Team Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical. But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand. The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories. About the Role We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform. The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories. This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. Identify and support new creator and developer categories Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem. Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities. Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior. Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership. title: Senior Principal Risk Analyst
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build. Notion is flexible, powerful and always evolving. It is a product that needs to scale to meet the needs of many thousands of businesses globally. Those customers rely on us to protect their data and their customers’ data. This is where you come in — to help us forge a strong, reliable path forward to the future. Notion is looking for a risk analyst who has a passion for partnering with teams across the organization to envision, plan and enhance Notion's risk management posture. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Mature and scale Notion’s security risk management program, creating practical, and repeatable processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and addressing risk. - Manage the security risk register, partnering with risk owners to document and prioritize risks, maintain current treatment plans, and track progress through resolution or approved acceptance. - Strengthen third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle, from due diligence and onboarding through continuous monitoring, reassessment, and offboarding. - Identify sensitive data exposure risks, assess and improve data loss prevention controls, and drive remediation that protects company and customer data. - Collaborate across Security, Engineering, IT, Procurement, Legal, and business teams to develop proportionate controls and move risk treatment plans forward. - Develop risk metrics and reporting that give leadership a clear view of the company’s risk posture, emerging concerns, and remediation progress. - Identify opportunities to improve and automate risk workflows, making it easier for teams to make informed decisions as Notion scales. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Security risk management: You have experience building or scaling information security risk programs, including work with risk assessments, risk registers, treatment plans, and risk acceptance processes. - Technical fluency: You understand security concepts across cloud infrastructure, applications, identity and access, and data protection, and can assess how control gaps translate into business risk. - Third-party risk expertise: You have experience evaluating vendor security practices, assessing residual risk, and managing risk throughout the third-party lifecycle. - Strategic judgment: You can prioritize competing risks, navigate ambiguity, and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance security, business needs, and operational realities. - Cross-functional influence: You build productive relationships with technical and business partners and drive progress without relying on direct authority. - Communication and reporting: You translate complex risks into clear, actionable narratives for audiences ranging from engineers and risk owners to senior leadership. - Builder mentality: You improve processes and use technology or automation to reduce manual work while maintaining sound oversight. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience or certifications in the governance, risk, or privacy domains. - Awareness of ongoing and recent developments across the security risk landscape. - Working knowledge of Notion and how AI agents can be used to enhance security programs. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $208,000 - $245,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. title: Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of the role</strong></h4> <p>As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.</li> <li>Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.</li> <li>Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.</li> <li>Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.</li> <li>Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.</li> <li>Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.</li> <li>Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.</li> <li>Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.</li> <li>Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.</li> <li>Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.</li> <li>Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.</li> <li>Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.</li> <li>Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.</li> <li>Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. In this role, you'll apply deep security expertise to answer technical questions, assess contract requirements, and enable GitLab’s Sales and field organizations to address security problems for enterprise customers. Manage escalations, collaborate across other teams, and develop solutions to enable team and business partners to close deals</li> <li>Document and track contract-related security obligations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer Engagement & Assurance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join customer and prospect meetings to provide expert guidance on GitLab’s security practices and controls in order to address security, privacy, and compliance requirements</li> <li>Build and maintain templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and training that simplify and accelerate negotiations</li> <li>Facilitate customer assurance activities through our Customer Assurance Activities Service Desk</li> <li>Provide escalation support for complex security questionnaires, RFPs, and risk assessments</li> <li>Serve as security point of contact for enterprise customer questions, requests, and concerns</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Evangelism & Thought Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted technical thought leader, developing internal and external security content such as blog posts, whitepapers, technical standards, and field sales enablement training materials</li> <li>Keep abreast of the rapidly evolving regulatory landscape affecting our agreements. Identify, track, and facilitate solutions for security related customer trends and improvement areas</li> <li>Build and strengthen GitLab's security brand within the industry</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Initiatives</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain and enhance GitLab's Trust Center and self-service security resources</li> <li>Provide strategic recommendations based on customer security concerns in support of revenue growth</li> <li>Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews to inform product and security roadmap decisions</li> <li>Mentor and provide guidance to Security Assurance team members</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement of Field Security processes and documentation</li> <li>Design and implement solutions to enable Sales facing teams to successfully discuss security problems and topics with customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expertise in law and regulation such as (GDPR, CCPA, DORA, EU AI Act)</li> <li>Deep experience in information security, with at least 5 years in customer-facing security roles</li> <li>Deep experience in security frameworks and standards such as (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, FedRAMP, NIST CSF, etc.)</li> <li>Proven track record of contract negotiation and security/privacy agreement reviews</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences</li> <li>Experience creating security content (blogs, whitepapers, presentations)</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud security, SaaS security models, and DevSecOps practices</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams</li> <li>Ability to balance security risk with business objectives</li> <li>Experience speaking at conferences is a plus</li> <li>Preferred: One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or CIPP/CIPM. Equivalent demonstrated experience is equally valued.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><em>Due to government requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position.</em></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering.<br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. As a Senior Security Risk Engineer, you'll take ownership of risk identification, quantification, and remediation tracking across the business, and you'll be a driving force behind automating and modernizing how the team does this work using AI and scripting. Reporting to the Security Risk Manager, you will bring expertise on risk methodology, risk-based thinking, and AI-enablement. </p> <p>In this role, you'll partner closely with Security, Legal, IT, Product, and Engineering to translate technical findings and vendor risk into business-relevant risk statements and risk treatments. You’ll help surface emerging risks, and report top risks to leadership. </p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Building and maintaining a risk register that translates technical vulnerabilities, control gaps, and third-party risk findings into quantified, business-relevant risk statements.</li> <li>Driving cross-functional remediation of security findings and risk issues to closure, tracked against SLAs.</li> <li>Driving automation and AI-enabled improvements for risk and GRC workflows so the team can spend less time on manual work and more time on high-value risk analysis and program maturity.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own risk identification, analysis, and prioritization across third-party risk (TPRM), security risk assessments, and security findings, using an established risk framework (e.g., NIST RMF, ISO 31000, or NIST 800-39). </li> <li>Translate technical vulnerabilities, control gaps, and risk findings into clear, quantified risk statements that non-security stakeholders and leadership can act on. </li> <li>Drive remediation of findings and risk exceptions to closure, partnering with Engineering, IT, Product, and Legal, and escalating stalled or high-severity items. </li> <li>Mature and maintain a risk register and quarterly reporting cadence that gives leadership clear visibility into open risk, remediation progress, and trends.</li> <li>Own and mature AI risk management, including AI impact assessments, AI risk assessments, and risk treatments, to support ISO 42001 certification.</li> <li>Design, develop, and implement key risk indicators and supporting metrics for top risks in the risk register.</li> <li>Identify manual, repetitive steps in risk and TPRM workflows and personally build the automation, scripting, or AI-enabled tooling to remove them. </li> <li>Contribute to the roadmap for the risk program, incorporating new frameworks, regulatory changes, and lessons learned from past assessments.</li> <li>Monitor the internal and external risk landscape (new frameworks, threat trends, business changes) to identify and escalate emerging risks before they become findings.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in security risk management, working with security-centric risk management or compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, NIST 800-39, ISO 31000). Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF) is a plus.</li> <li>Experience designing and executing qualitative and quantitative risk analyses that translate technical risks into measurable business impact. </li> <li>A track record of driving risk assessments, risk registers, and remediation efforts to closure across IT, Procurement, Internal Audit, Legal, Product, and Engineering, in a heavily regulated or multi-entity environment.</li> <li>Experience interpreting technical control requirements and translating them for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated bias toward automation: you've personally built scripts, workflows, or AI-enabled tooling that reduced manual risk or GRC work, not just evaluated tools conceptually. </li> <li>Comfort operating with ambiguity, managing multiple concurrent assessments, and reprioritizing under tight deadlines. </li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to translate security risks into business risks.</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud security, SaaS security models, and DevSecOps practices.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC) are preferred but not required. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The <strong>Security Assurance </strong>organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk across the company. The Security Risk team sits within that group and owns third-party risk (TPRM), security risk assessments, and remediation of security findings. The Security Risk Team performs thorough, collaborative, and efficient risk assessments as well as drive risk reduction so that GitLab can achieve its goals while maintaining a high level of security. title: Backend Software Developer
description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Revenue Technology Manager at GitLab, you'll lead how the tools we build and buy work together as we grow our consumption-based business. You'll own the vision, roadmap, and requirements for internal go-to-market applications, starting with Command Center, which helps field teams act on product usage and consumption data. You'll decide what those applications need to do and how they should fit with the rest of the stack. Engineering will own their technical architecture, code, and infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director, Revenue Technology, within Revenue Operations.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.</li> <li value="2">Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.</li> <li value="3">Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Engineering to deliver applications that fit the existing stack and limit technical debt. Lead user acceptance testing, launch, documentation, and enablement, then use adoption data to decide what to improve, expand, or retire.</li> <li value="5">Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.</li> <li value="6">Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.</li> <li value="7">Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.</li> <li value="2">Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.</li> <li value="3">Hands-on experience with a consumption- or usage-based business model, including how teams use consumption metrics across the customer lifecycle.</li> <li value="4">Experience delivering internal tools with engineering teams, including writing scoped requirements and acceptance criteria and running user acceptance testing before release.</li> <li value="5">Experience making build-versus-buy or consolidation decisions based on cost, return on investment, and business fit. You can reconcile competing requests from senior stakeholders and explain your decisions clearly.</li> <li value="6">Experience shipping artificial intelligence agents or workflows people rely on, with the judgment to know where automation helps and where it adds complexity.</li> <li value="7">Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.</li> </ul> <p>Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. working independently while seeking input at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Practical Judgment:</strong> Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.</li> </ul> logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.</li> <li>Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.</li> </ul> <div location: Remote Ireland; Remote, Spain; Remote, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p> <p>Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.</p> <p>We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.</li> <li>Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.</li> <li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.</li> <li>Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.</li> <li>Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.</li> <li>Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.</li> <li>Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fluency in German.</li> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
