title: Senior Third Party Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>⭐️ Our Third Party & Outsourcing Risk Management Team</strong></p> <p>We are a high-performing Global team focused on delivering pragmatic Third Party Risk Management (‘TPRM’) that protects Monzo and our customers globally. As Monzo expands across new markets and scales its product range, the operational footprint is growing fast, and the operating environment is becoming more complex.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Third Party Risk Manager </strong>to help shape and deliver our approach.  As well as ensuring Monzo’s TPRM has well defined controls, processes and governance models in place to meet the continually growing and evolving demands of global Third Party Risk Management regulations - you’ll also set priorities and turn them into measurable improvements.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Third Party Risk, this is a <strong>hands-on </strong>role, with strategic scope. You’ll work across the global team, and with a variety of stakeholders throughout Monzo, to strengthen our framework, manage complex risks and improve how we deliver TPRM both tactically and strategically. </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivering Core TPRM Operations Globally</strong>: Operating end-to-end operational activities, including supplier tiering, materiality assessments, due diligence reviews, exit planning support, and regulatory reporting.</li> <li><strong>Driving Operational Excellence:</strong> Taking ownership of process quality, making sure TPRM activities are completed accurately, consistently and on time. You’ll look for ways to improve how we manage third party risk in practice.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our priorities: </strong>Identifying emerging risks, gaps and opportunities across third party risk management, and making recommendations to inform the team’s strategy and roadmap. You’ll develop practical solutions and help deliver improvements through to completion.</li> <li><strong>Enabling Strategic Delivery:</strong> Supporting and feeding into higher-level strategic initiatives and complex risk landscapes. Leading agreed initiatives from problem definition through implementation autonomously, working across teams and global markets to deliver measurable improvements and ensuring clear visibility throughout.</li> <li><strong>Collaborating Across Teams:</strong> Working directly with internal stakeholders across the 3LOD, and external suppliers to clear blockers, follow up on actions, and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Sharing your expertise:</strong> Support colleagues and stakeholders with practical guidance, helping them understand how to deliver their third party risk responsibilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You know Outsourcing, Third Party Risk & Regulation: </strong>You have substantial practical TPRM experience (ideally in banking or financial services) operating in both the UK and EU financial markets.  </li> <li><strong>You’ve contributed to a risk strategy, framework or operating model: </strong>You can demonstrate how you translated an identified gap into a practical improvement.</li> <li><strong>You’re comfortable leading complex assessments:</strong> You make balanced, well-reasoned recommendations when information is incomplete or stakeholders have different priorities.</li> <li><strong>You have experience working with various technologies</strong>: TPR tooling and AI to build innovative solutions and streamline operational workflows.</li> <li><strong>You hold a high quality bar:</strong> You pay close attention to detail and care about accuracy. You use data and reporting to spot patterns, make evidence-based decisions and improve processes.</li> <li><strong>You take ownership:</strong> You work independently, take initiative and prioritise your workload in a fast-moving environment. You use sound risk judgement and know when to seek guidance or involve others.</li> <li><strong>You focus on outcomes, not just activity: </strong>You measure success by what has materially improved whether that's faster turnaround times, clearer risk ownership, or cleaner supplier data.</li> <li><strong>You are a clear, pragmatic communicator: </strong>You build strong relationships with internal teams, third parties and regulators. You’re comfortable holding colleagues accountable and offering constructive challenges when needed. You bring together input from specialists across Information Security, Data Protection, Legal and Operational Resilience to form a clear view of risk.</li> <li><strong>You are comfortable escalating: </strong>You use sound judgement to know when to involve your team or manager in emerging issues or concerns, and communicate your priorities and workload clearly and regularly, defaulting to transparency and taking accountability.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £85,000 - £115,000  ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Full-Loop Interviews (1 x Role Specific + 1 x Behavioural)<br><br></li> </ul> <p>📆 <strong>Please Note</strong>: We pause hiring from 14th Dec 2026 - 4th January 2027. </p> <p><strong>Full Loop interviews will take place in January 2027 🥳Thanks for your patience!</strong></p> <p>⏳We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> <p>#CM-1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Customer Success LATAM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Customer Success Manager for Latin America (LATAM), you’ll help GitLab customers in the region realize the full value of our development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform by driving adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term advocacy. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, the software development lifecycle, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices.</p> <p>This role requires more technical depth than a typical Customer Success Manager role, but not the same level of technical expertise as a Customer Success Engineer. You’ll need to learn and use GitLab hands-on, triage technical questions, and guide customers on product and infrastructure best practices, while keeping adoption and business outcomes at the center of your work.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Centers of Excellence efforts, and translate product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, with success in your first year measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Build and maintain a trusted advisor relationship with each assigned customer in LATAM, focusing on adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term satisfaction with GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Triage customers’ technical questions, provide product and infrastructure best practices, and help customers establish a GitLab Center of Excellence within their organization.</li> <li value="3">Lead workshops and provide hands-on product enablement to help customers understand and use the full value of the GitLab solution across their software development lifecycle.</li> <li value="4">Measure and monitor customers’ progress against critical and key performance indicators, and share insights with GitLab account stakeholders and customer sponsors and executives.</li> <li value="5">Translate customer product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive adoption and expansion of GitLab within customer environments.</li> <li value="6">Establish and manage regular touchpoints with customers in line with service level agreements to review strategic and technical objectives and adjust plans as needed.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services to streamline issue resolution, share customer feedback, and align on customer success plans.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Business-level fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with the LATAM market.</li> <li value="3">Experience across the full customer journey, including post-sales adoption, value realization, and advocacy.</li> <li value="4">Background in customer success, professional services, technical account management, or a related function with direct customer engagement.</li> <li value="5">Ability to understand and discuss Git, common branching strategies, and how customers use version control in their workflows.</li> <li value="6">Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including typical development pipelines and tooling.</li> <li value="7">Ability to learn and use GitLab, triage technical questions, share product and infrastructure best practices, and provide hands-on product enablement for customers.</li> <li value="8">Basic-to-intermediate knowledge of development and operations (DevOps), including familiarity with continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps concepts and practices.</li> <li value="9">Skill in translating product usage data and technical details into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive stakeholders.</li> <li value="10">Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and coworkers, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.</li> <li value="11">Ability to manage multiple customer needs simultaneously and maintain clear, thorough documentation.</li> <li value="12">Commitment to learning and growing, with a willingness to investigate questions and work through problems independently.</li> <li value="13">Transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li value="1">Prior experience at a startup.</li> <li value="2">Prior experience at a GitLab competitor.</li> <li value="3">Intermediate-to-advanced DevOps knowledge.</li> <li value="4">Prior experience leading executive-level conversations.</li> <li value="5">Prior experience selling services.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. In this role, you’ll support customers in LATAM as part of a globally distributed, all-remote team. We collaborate asynchronously with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other groups to connect customer needs with GitLab’s product and services. We focus on helping our customers establish GitLab best practices, including Centers of Excellence, and on turning usage data into actionable insights that support strategic and technical objectives.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. You'll contribute to validation approaches and feedback mechanisms that help agents catch that gap and self-correct while they work.</p> <p>This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We’re looking for someone who has built with agents, run into the gap between passing tests and working software, and wants to help close it.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own whether agent-generated code delivers the intended behavior.</li> <li>Implement feedback that helps agents identify problems and self-correct during development.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering languages.</li> <li>Experience taking backend features from design into production, discussing implementation trade-offs, and knowing when to ask for guidance.</li> <li>Comfort working inside a large existing codebase, not only on greenfield projects.</li> <li>A practical approach to prototyping, learning from results, and turning useful ideas into working software.</li> <li>Clear written communication and the ability to collaborate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to share decisions transparently and improve your work through iteration and feedback.</li> <li>Familiarity with containerized services; Kubernetes experience is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Social Media, you'll lead GitLab's global social media strategy and help people understand how GitLab is co-creating the future of software development. The role shapes how GitLab shows up across social channels, connecting our company, product, and employer stories, to build meaningful engagement with customers, users, contributors, candidates, and industry audiences. Expect to set clear priorities, guide execution, and use insights to strengthen GitLab's voice and business impact. You'll own the outcomes of GitLab's social function — strategy, budget, team development, tooling, and results — and serve as GitLab's senior-most voice on social strategy with executive stakeholders.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy and stay close enough to the work to write, build, and ship alongside the team. Two Social Media Managers report to the head of corporate communication and work with you on a dotted-line basis. You'll set their strategic direction, raise the editorial and craft bar, and develop them as practitioners, including goal-setting, feedback, and career development in partnership with their manager. Influence matters in this role, which is why it calls for someone who has already led and grown social practitioners. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the performance of GitLab's social function and its contribution to marketing and business goals.</li> <li>Lead GitLab's global organic social media strategy, channel plans, and editorial priorities.</li> <li>Own GitLab's YouTube strategy end to end — channel architecture, programming and series development, long- and short-form video, packaging (titles, thumbnails, metadata), search and recommendation optimization, and subscriber and watch-time growth.</li> <li>Partner with Growth Marketing on paid social, including briefing creative, aligning organic and paid on shared audiences and messaging, informing boosting and amplification decisions, and connecting paid performance back to organic strategy.</li> <li>Develop clear, audience-focused campaigns that support company, product, brand, and talent goals.</li> <li>Guide content planning and publishing across social channels while maintaining a consistent GitLab voice.</li> <li>Own the social media budget, tooling stack, and agency, freelance, and production partner relationships.</li> <li>Partner with teams across Marketing, Communications, Product, Sales, Talent Acquisition, and other functions to plan and deliver social programs.</li> <li>Build processes that support effective collaboration in GitLab's all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience insights, and performance data to improve content and inform broader marketing decisions.</li> <li>Lead the measurement framework for social — KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence — and report performance and learnings to marketing and executive leadership.</li> <li>Partner with DevRel on community engagement to help GitLab participate in relevant industry conversations with a clear, useful point of view.</li> <li>Build and run creator, influencer, and advocacy programs, including developer creators, GitLab community contributors, and team member advocacy.</li> <li>Own GitLab's employee advocacy program — grow participation across Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and Talent, equip team members with content worth sharing, and measure reach, engagement, and contribution to brand and talent goals. Partner with Communications and Talent Acquisition on enablement, and manage the advocacy platform and its adoption.</li> <li>Support executive and expert social presence, partnering with Communications to help GitLab leaders and technical experts show up credibly on social, including constructive conversations with C-suite executives about proposed content.</li> <li>Apply AI tools thoughtfully across the social workflow to help GitLab model what an AI-native marketing team looks like.</li> <li>Prepare for and guide responses to sensitive or fast-moving issues in partnership with the appropriate teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years in social media, including at least 5 years leading social strategy for a global brand at the senior manager level or above, and accountable for the function's results.</li> <li>Experience owning a social function end to end, including strategy, budget, headcount, tooling, and results as the accountable leader. </li> <li>Experience leading teams, agencies, and cross-functional programs, with clear ownership of and accountability for outcomes.</li> <li>Depth in YouTube strategy, including owning and growing a brand or business channel, and can speak to programming decisions, video formats, packaging, and the metrics that actually move a channel.</li> <li>Hands-on experience growing LinkedIn and X as primary channels, with judgment about what content, format, and cadence work on each.</li> <li>Experience with paid social programs and how organic and paid social reinforce each other, including creative for paid, audience strategy, and interpreting paid performance data.</li> <li>Experience connecting social media programs to broader brand, communications, product, or business priorities.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex topics into clear, engaging content.</li> <li>Fluency with short-form and long-form video as core social formats, including working with production partners and creators.</li> <li>Experience defining a measurement framework for social, including KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence, and presenting performance, learnings, and recommendations to executive leadership on a standing basis.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling an employee advocacy program, including driving adoption across multiple functions, sustaining participation beyond launch, and reporting attributed reach and business contribution</li> <li>Fluency with an enterprise social stack for publishing, listening, and advocacy. Ours is Sprout Social, Meltwater, and EveryoneSocial.</li> <li>Experience running social programs across multiple regions and languages, and judgment about what to localize versus centralize.</li> <li>Skill in managing multiple priorities and making sound decisions in fast-moving situations.</li> <li>A collaborative, inclusive approach and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Passion about GitLab's mission and the future of software development, open source, artificial intelligence, and DevSecOps.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>This role is part of GitLab's Marketing organization and works across teams to present a clear, consistent company voice on social media. The team collaborates asynchronously with partners across regions and functions, balancing planned campaigns with timely engagement. Together, you'll help audiences understand GitLab's platform, mission, values, and impact.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior or Staff Backend Engineer with the <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/data-engineering/database-excellence/">Database Excellence group</a>, you'll build and evolve database automation and PostgreSQL as a service capabilities for GitLab. The level will be determined during the hiring process. You'll use Go to automate the full lifecycle of PostgreSQL across GitLab's infrastructure, making database operations safer, more consistent, and easier to scale for databases that sit behind high-throughput, always-on internet services. You'll work closely with partner teams to shape how GitLab provisions and manages PostgreSQL in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/database-team/traffic-replay-poc">SQL Traffic Replay Tooling</a>, which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.</li> <li value="2"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/database-team/backend/-/work_items/1">PostgreSQL as a Service Platform</a>, which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.</li> <li value="3"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-com/gl-infra/data-access/dbo/-/work_items/75">PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation</a>, which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.</li> <li value="2">Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.</li> <li value="3">Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.</li> <li value="4">Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.</li> <li value="5">Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.</li> <li value="6">Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.</li> <li value="8">Research, design, and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, and data health, helping maintain more than 8 months of operational runway for all critical database saturation points.</li> <li value="9">Review database automation and Go changes from other engineers and contributors, with attention to safety, maintainability, and performance.</li> <li value="10">Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and guidance that helps engineers use and contribute to the platform.</li> <li value="11">Build safe, repeatable automation for PostgreSQL major version upgrades at GitLab.com scale, validating changes against real production traffic before rollout.</li> <li value="12">Operate what you build in production from end to end, using production feedback to guide each iteration.</li> <li value="12">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating a database-as-a-service product.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency with Go, including designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.</li> <li value="3">Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or similar automation for the lifecycle of stateful services, especially databases. Kubernetes experience is one way to demonstrate this skill, but isn't required; comparable experience building database or infrastructure automation is welcome.</li> <li value="4">Comfort with infrastructure as code and core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with Ruby is a plus but isn't required. Much of GitLab's application codebase uses Ruby on Rails, and being able to read it helps when designing automation that application teams depend on. small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in at least value="3">Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.</li> <li value="4">Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.</li> <li value="5">Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.</li> <li value="6">A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).</li> <li value="7">Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.</li> <li value="8">Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></p> <p>GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.</p> <p>We collaborate asynchronously rather than following a feature factory model. Navigate contracting vehicles, funding cycles, and agency-specific buying processes to secure multi-year contracts and expansions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape the sales approach for regulated environments, connecting FedRAMP-authorized offerings and mission-critical DevSecOps use cases to agency needs and increasing platform adoption.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with Renewals, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and federal partners on account plans, product roadmap feedback, and campaigns that support retention and expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Expand within large agencies through new workloads, cross-sells, and upsells, balancing near-term revenue with long-term platform adoption.</p> </li> <li> <p>Meet customers in the field and travel as needed for key account meetings, large-deal reviews, and team engagements. delivering high-performance services at scale, ideally site reliability engineers or infrastructure engineers running production software as a service systems.</li> <li value="2">Technical depth in background job processing and caching technologies such as Redis and Sidekiq, sufficient to guide decisions about upgrades, capacity, and failure modes.</li> <li value="3">Experience managing reliability against service-level objectives, including defining service-level indicators, setting up burn-rate alerting, and planning capacity.</li> <li value="4">Experience running a 24/7 on-call rotation and coordinating high-severity incidents.</li> <li value="5">A track record of balancing operational work and incident follow-ups with roadmap projects, and pushing back on scope when deadlines can't be met.</li> <li value="6">Experience leading a fully remote team across time zones in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Async team runs GitLab.com's background processing layer, from the Sidekiq infrastructure to the shared code that enqueues jobs. Product teams build the jobs; we keep the platform that runs them fast and reliable. Our Redis clusters support caching, sessions, rate limiting, queues, and shared state. We also support data durability through backup and restore verification, object storage, and operational support for Git repository storage. That work includes restore drills, capacity rebalancing, and provisioning. We staff GitLab.com's first-tier production on-call rotation in 8-hour shifts across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, triaging every paging alert and bringing in the right team when needed.</p> <p> </p> <p class="p1"><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Senior Platform Engineer We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams. The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering You will be responsible for: Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices. Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling. Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves. Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery. Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline. Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed. Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems. Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same. Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback. Shaping engineering standards through our guilds Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with. Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value. Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined About you Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams. Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups. Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale. Strong in GitLab CI and designing reusable pipelines and templates for many teams. Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus. Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting. Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM. Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong. Have grown other engineers and can explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. We’ll treat you with: 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process Equal Opportunities Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Red Team Lead
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. What we're looking for We're looking for a Red Team Lead to establish our Red Team and strengthen the security culture at Supabase. As the team lead, you'll build the team and work alongside them to plan and execute realistic attack simulations across the entire tech stack. You'll guide the team to turn findings into practical recommendations that drive meaningful security improvements. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical expertise with thoughtful, people-first leadership. Success in this role means our team brings security at Supabase to new heights. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Develop our Red Team from the ground up. - Lead and mentor a team that values technical depth, curiosity, collaboration, and accountability, where people can challenge ideas and learn. Align their efforts with their career growth and organizational security goals. - Stay technically connected to the planning and execution of operations. Guide the team to make sound judgment calls and communicate operational impact to various audiences. - Define the team's strategic roadmap and operational practices for our environment and threat landscape. Use metrics and impact narratives to communicate the team's success. - Build strategic relationships with relevant teams, including Legal, Engineering, IT, HR, and Finance, for cross-functional influence and amplified security impact. Foster a collaborative relationship with defensive teams. - Advise leadership on strategic growth beyond the Red Team. - Establish Supabase as a thought leader in the security space. Share appropriate research and lessons publicly through writing or talks. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have experience leading adversary emulation teams, especially balancing hands-on work and management as a player-coach. - Have experience with global asynchronous teams and can work independently. - Are familiar with cloud-native offensive operations, including cloud and CI/CD pipelines, and creating and securely deploying command-and-control (C2), reconnaissance tools, and infrastructure for adversary simulations. - Understand attack techniques targeting browsers, cloud infrastructure, databases, SaaS applications, supply chains, Linux and macOS devices, and identity and access systems. - Naturally build rapport, trust, and engagement within Security and across the organization. - Work collaboratively with kindness and respect. - Can clearly communicate complex security concepts to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: General Counsel (remote)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong> to lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function and to build the legal architecture a public company needs — commercial contracting, corporate governance, intellectual property and compliance — in a software business that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and advise the CEO, CFO and the Board directly.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This role can be home-based in EMEA, or office-based in our London, UK office.</p> <h3><strong>About our team</strong></h3> <p>Canonical’s Legal and Compliance function is a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. It owns the terms on which Ubuntu and our commercial products reach the market: open source and intellectual property licensing, enterprise and channel contracting, data protection, export controls and trade, competition, and the governance a company preparing to list has to be able to evidence.</p> <p>Canonical is founder-led, profitable and growing, and privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. That makes this a function in transition. The work is as much building the architecture — a management layer across two regions, standard contracting positions, controls, policies and records — as it is advising on live matters, and it is done in a company that regularly does things the industry has not done before, so the precedents often do not exist.</p> <p>The team works with Product and Engineering on licensing and IP, with Security on customer assurance, with Finance on listing readiness and controls, and with Sales on the commitments we make to customers. As General Counsel you lead that team, set its standards, and advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board and its committees directly.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global Legal and Compliance function: set its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas, so the business gets consistent answers wherever it operates.</li> <li>Build the management layer: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Set the operating cadence of the function: how legal work is taken in and prioritised, what internal clients can expect and when, and how workload and risk are reported to the leadership team.</li> <li>Own public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and support Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Own the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Lead intellectual property and open source licensing strategy: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Own the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition, and AI regulation.</li> <li>Manage litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, and own the external counsel panel, its budget and the quality of its work.</li> <li>Advise on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified as a lawyer, with a law degree or equivalent and an active licence to practise in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>In-house legal leadership in a software or technology company — a business that licenses its own products, rather than one that buys technology to run its operations.</li> <li>Commercial technology contracting: enterprise software and subscription agreements, channel and reseller agreements, cloud and services, and hardware manufacturer agreements.</li> <li>Open source licensing: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and how open source communities work in practice.</li> <li>Corporate governance for a listed company, or for one preparing to list: board and committee support, delegated authority, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>Building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally two to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practising as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Architect, Japan & Korea
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As Manager, Forward Deployed Architect, Japan & Korea, you will lead a team that helps enterprise customers turn AI ambition into operational reality. You will manage and develop Forward Deployed Architects across Japan and Korea, helping customers build meaningful workflows and solutions while establishing the practices that enable consistent, high-quality delivery. This is a player-coach role for a builder, seller, and people leader. Your primary impact will come through the performance and growth of your team, rather than through personally owning delivery. You will stay close to customers and engagements, working with account teams from presales through delivery, coaching your team, and contributing hands-on when needed. You will report to the Head of Services, Forward Deployed, APAC. You will partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcome Architects to identify opportunities, shape engagements, and connect proposed solutions to customer outcomes. You will also manage staffing and delivery, support commercial and contractual processes, and build repeatable ways of working with internal teams and service partners. You will partner with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) managers on engagements that require engineering expertise. The FDA organization owns time-bound Services engagements, including discovery, solution architecture, implementation, launch readiness, enablement, outcome delivery, and handoff. FDE owns engineering-intensive implementation requiring production code or deep technical specialization. Together, you will establish clear engagement boundaries, staffing and escalation mechanisms, quality standards, and a unified customer experience. This is an opportunity to help define what forward-deployed work looks like at Notion as we evolve into an Agent OS. You will help customers put new AI-powered workflows into practice, share what works with partners, and shape an emerging service in a fast-changing environment. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE Customer delivery - Guide the Japan and Korea portfolio from discovery and solution design through implementation, enablement, and handoff, keeping customer outcomes at the center of each engagement. - Review delivery health, scope, budget, timelines, and risks; coach team members through challenges and support escalations and change requests. - Stay close to strategic engagements and customer stakeholders, providing guidance and executive support when needed. - Assign the right team members to engagements, establish co-delivery approaches, and provide hands-on implementation support when needed. - Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and other stakeholders when engagements require engineering expertise, with clear ownership and handoffs. - Improve delivery quality and consistency through playbooks, templates, reference architectures, quality reviews, and lessons learned, developed and shared with teams and service partners. Pre-sales and solution scoping - Partner with Solutions Consultants, Outcome Architects, and account teams to identify customer needs and opportunities for paid and unpaid Services engagements. - Lead or support discovery and shape proposals, defining desired business outcomes, solution approach, deliverables, implementation plans, timelines, and risks. - Qualify and prioritize incoming opportunities against customer needs, commercial value, delivery risk, and available capacity. Make clear decisions to accept, defer, redirect, or decline work. - Develop a target-account strategy and proactively drive joint Services proposals with Solutions Consultants during your first six months. - Manage Services opportunities and forecasts, and support customer contracts, waivers, and change orders throughout the engagement lifecycle. - Turn recurring customer needs into packaged solutions, and share field insights and lessons with regional peers, Product, Engineering, PMM, and Services leadership. Team management and operations - Hire, onboard, manage, and retain Forward Deployed Architects across Japan and Korea, setting clear expectations and managing performance against the FDA levels framework. - Develop team members through engagement reviews, shadowing, work-product feedback, coaching, and regular career conversations. - Turn delivery experience into practical guidance and training; set standards for discovery, solution architecture, implementation, engagement leadership, and customer enablement. - Manage staffing and capacity across presales and delivery, matching work to skills and availability while protecting time for onboarding, coaching, and reusable assets. - Build effective operating practices and run a regular cadence to review pipeline, demand, allocation, delivery health, and risks, adjusting priorities as needs change. - Collaborate with FDA and FDE managers in other regions to share engagement updates, learning, and best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 5+ years of experience in professional services, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing technology role. - Experience across the enterprise services lifecycle, from presales and discovery through proposals, contract management, and delivery. Strong commercial and delivery judgment, including estimation, margin awareness, risk, change control, and escalation. - Experience managing and developing a team, including hiring, onboarding, feedback, performance management, career development, and team health. - Ability to turn personal expertise into repeatable coaching, training, and standards that improve team performance, and experience developing packaged services or reusable delivery methods and assets. - Experience managing staffing and capacity across concurrent engagements, and designing intake and prioritization processes that balance customer urgency, strategic value, delivery risk, and available capacity. - Hands-on experience building and delivering technology or AI solutions, with tangible examples and a builder mindset. Technical fluency across areas such as AI workflows, enterprise systems, APIs, integrations, data, automation, and governance; production coding is not required, but you must be able to reason through tradeoffs and partner credibly with FDE. - Strong customer-facing discovery, communication, problem-solving, and solution architecture skills, with the ability to review complex work, guide teams, and align stakeholders around outcomes. - Fluency in Japanese and English, and the ability to work across teams and customers in Japan and Korea. - Comfort navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and adapting strategy and execution as the business evolves. NICE TO HAVES - Fluency in Korean. - Experience designing, building, or selling AI agent workflows. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCP, Workers, coding agents, or developer-platform workflows. Prior Notion experience is not required. - Experience partnering with engineering teams and service partners on customer engagements. - Experience building or improving a team, practice, or operating model. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Contractor (AUS)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>This is a contract opportunity*</strong></h4> <h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll be a key partner to Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting leadership, helping them execute hiring plans, coordinate interviews, and maintain accurate, transparent processes in our applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles. You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition.</li> <li>Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li>Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly.</li> <li>Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process.</li> <li>Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team.</li> <li>Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters.</li> <li>Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab.</li> <li>Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment.</li> <li>Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. You'll join a collaborative group that coordinates interview logistics, manages candidate flow in our applicant tracking system, and supports offer and onboarding handoffs so candidates and hiring teams have a clear, organized experience at every stage. The team works asynchronously across time zones, using GitLab and shared documentation to stay aligned while handling high-volume hiring. Our focus is on refining processes, maintaining accurate data, and acting as brand ambassadors for GitLab's values in every candidate interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Multigres Deployment Engineer
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for an engineer to own the deployment and operational infrastructure of Multigres, our distributed Postgres platform. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the Multigres Operator, ensuring reliable cloud deployments, and creating the tooling that powers our Kubernetes-based infrastructure. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Build and maintain the Multigres Operator - Maintain our Go-based Kubernetes operator that orchestrates distributed Postgres deployments - Architect cloud deployment infrastructure - Design and implement robust deployment patterns for EKS and other Kubernetes platforms - Manage storage and networking layers - Work with CSI drivers, persistent volumes, and cross-cloud networking to ensure data reliability and connectivity - Develop deployment tooling - Create internal tools and automation for provisioning, scaling, and managing Multigres clusters - Ensure operational excellence - Build monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities into the deployment layer - Collaborate across teams - Work with database engineers, SRE, and product teams to deliver seamless deployment experiences YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE: - Strong systems programming skills - Proficiency in Go and experience building production-grade operators or controllers - Deep Kubernetes expertise - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, custom resources, and cloud-managed Kubernetes services (EKS, GKE, AKS) - Database operations knowledge - Understanding of database deployment patterns, backup/restore, replication, and high availability - Distributed systems experience - Familiarity with consensus protocols, failure scenarios, and designing for resilience - Cloud infrastructure background - Experience with cloud-native deployment tooling, IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), and cloud provider APIs - Production operations mindset - Track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with CSI storage drivers and storage orchestration in Kubernetes - Knowledge of cross-cloud networking tools like Cilium, Istio, or similar service mesh technologies - Prior work with sharded query serving systems like Vitess - Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.</p> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001.
