Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.</li> <li value="4">Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.</li> <li value="6">Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.</li> <li value="7">Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.</li> <li value="8">Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Experience delivering safety and resilience programs across several countries, covering occupational health and safety plus either crisis management or business continuity.</li> <li value="2">Knowledge of when to consult team members or works councils, hold hearings, or make decisions jointly, and how to document each step. To handle GitLab's legal obligations in Germany, you'll need direct experience applying the Betriebsverfassungsgesetz and Arbeitssicherheitsgesetz.</li> <li value="3">Ability to apply ISO 45001, ISO 22361, ISO 22301, the ANSI/ASIS workplace violence prevention standard, and the European Union framework directive on safety and health at work when drafting policies and procedures with legal and compliance partners and external advisers.</li> <li value="4">Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.</li> <li value="5">Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.</li> <li value="6">Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.</li> <li value="7">Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.</li> <li value="8">Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Safety or business continuity credentials, ISO 45001 or ISO 22301 lead implementer or auditor qualifications, and works council or labor relations training are also helpful.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></h3> <p>We work with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, the crisis management team, team member representatives, and external partners. You'll bring these partners together through plans with named owners and deadlines. Our People Safety & Security scorecard tracks how well we meet safety standards and legal duties and which consultations, exercises, and incident reviews we've completed. It also tracks whether we've reviewed continuity plans in the past twelve months and closed audit findings by their deadlines.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale. This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume. - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping. - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage. - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on. - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load. - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles. - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter. - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck. - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance Qualification path How to get started: Complete your contributor profile and application Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training Receive your project assignment and access credentials Service Rates The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Storage Platform Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK - Integrate networked block storage into our Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration - Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network - Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification - Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors can't degrade other tenants - Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability to hold the system to them - Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching - Keep the platform portable across AWS, other clouds, and bare-metal/colo - Write design docs, mentor engineers, and work closely with the Compute, Branching, Postgres, and Multicloud teams - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and operating storage systems in production - Have built or operated distributed or software-defined block storage (for example Ceph RBD, Lightbits, Simplyblock, Portworx, LINSTOR/DRBD, or an in-house system) - Have hands-on experience with NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, including targets, initiators, multipath, and failover behavior - Have a deep understanding of Linux storage internals: the block layer, io_uring, page cache, O_DIRECT and fsync semantics, filesystems, and device-mapper - Write strong systems code in Go, plus C, C++, or Rust - Measure performance rigorously with fio, pgbench, eBPF, and perf, and can explain latency down to its individual components - Understand durability tradeoffs between replication, erasure coding, and consistency under failure - Have led technical direction on a complex system: design docs, tradeoffs, and bringing others along - Have experience with Kubernetes controllers and/or CSI drivers - Have been on call for large production systems - Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams NICE TO HAVE: - SPDK development experience - RDMA/RoCE experience - Experience implementing block-level snapshots, thin provisioning, or copy-on-write cloning - Postgres internals knowledge (WAL, buffer manager, checkpointer), or familiarity with OrioleDB - Experience with AWS networking and instance storage at scale (ENA, placement, bandwidth limits) - Experience running storage on bare metal or in colo - Contributions to open source storage projects or the Linux kernel storage stack WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li value="8">Technology or business-to-business (B2B) software recruiting experience is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You'll join a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Guided by GitLab's operating principles, including Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, we take ownership, move with urgency and rigor, and focus on hiring outcomes that matter to our internal customers. You keep their priorities aligned through scheduling, meeting preparation, clear communication, and follow-through. In your first year, you build trusted relationships across their teams and with partner EBAs. You establish reliable processes for meeting preparation and follow-through, travel, expenses, recruiting coordination, team events and offsites, and the cross-functional requests that come with customer escalations. This role is based in the United States or Canada and requires Pacific time hours (about 8 AM to 5 PM PT) and some flexibility to support meetings across global time zones. Flag dependencies, upcoming deliverables, and items that need review, decisions, or escalation before they slip.</li> <li>Plan and execute all-hands, ask-me-anything sessions, organizational summits, leadership offsites, and team-level engineering events, including hands-on support for our annual R&D summit (1,000+ attendees). Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, Information Technology, and Security on onboarding and team logistics.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, visas, security needs, and supporting documentation. Anticipate disruptions, arrange alternatives, and process accurate expense reports and reimbursements on time.</li> <li>Improve administrative processes, documentation, and leadership trackers so priorities and next steps stay clear. Provide coverage and share practices across the executive business administrator community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting VP-level or senior leaders, ideally in a fast-paced software, SaaS or AI environment (engineering or CTO exposure is a plus), with an understanding of their planning cycles and reviews.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars, travel, expenses, and shifting priorities for multiple senior leaders, with sound judgment about competing requests.</li> <li>Experience running all-hands and offsites end to end for teams of 200 or more in a remote or hybrid setting, including managing dependencies and responding to disruptions.</li> <li>A project management approach: define owners, due dates, and next steps; anticipate risks; and keep multiple workstreams moving independently. Comfort tracking action items in GitLab issues and epics or similar tools such as Jira.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to turn information from multiple sources into useful agendas, summaries, and preparation materials. An asynchronous-first approach, with documentation as part of your day-to-day work.</li> <li>Discretion with sensitive information, including organizational changes, performance matters, and incidents, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and backgrounds.</li> <li>Comfort using Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, or similar administrative and expense platforms, and flexibility to support meetings across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, including outside standard hours when needed.</li> <li>Proactive, responsive, ownership-minded executive support with a white-glove approach, a great attitude, and the ability to act without being asked.</li> <li>A strong team player who communicates openly with the executive support team and covers for peers when needed.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI tools (Claude is our standard) to improve administrative work, with the judgment to check outputs for accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s CTO organization, supporting multiple senior engineering leaders (typically two to three members of the engineering leadership team). communication and alignment.</li> <li value="5">Ability to generate new business and expand existing accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that result in sustainable, You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll join leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders, their teams, and the other executive support partners, and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs four to six weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion. You’ll move quickly, build AI-powered workflows to automate recurring work, and be a warm, approachable partner to the people on both leaders’ teams.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Protect focus time, recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.</li> <li>Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.</li> <li>Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.</li> <li>Partner with senior directors and team leads across both organizations, helping when it moves the leaders’ priorities and bringing the leaders in when it matters.</li> <li>Support team connection by remembering milestones and getting notes, gifts, or flowers out quickly.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.</li> <li>Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.</li> <li>Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects.</li> <li>Build and maintain artificial intelligence (AI) workflows, with Claude as our standard, to automate research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone.</li> <li>Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-growing company, ideally SaaS or AI-forward, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>A bias for action and ownership: you move from ask to done quickly, act independently within agreed priorities, and communicate progress proactively, with an organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities.</li> <li>Comfort figuring things out on your own in a fast-changing environment with limited resources.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.</li> <li>Project management title: Solutions Architect - SLED (East)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a SLED Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted technical advisor to State, Local, and Education customers in every state east of the Mississippi River: state agencies, counties, cities, special districts, community colleges, and public, private, and research universities. These organizations deliver services residents and students rely on every day, often with lean IT teams, aging systems, fixed fiscal-year budgets, and growing cybersecurity threats.</p> <p>You'll show them how GitLab's DevSecOps platform and AI capabilities, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, help them modernize legacy applications, protect sensitive resident and student data, meet state and sector compliance requirements, and do more with the staff they have. You'll own the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle, guide customers through proofs of concept and value, and translate platform capabilities into outcomes that agency leaders, CIOs, CISOs, and procurement officers can defend in a budget request or an RFP evaluation.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with SLED account executives, channel partners, and systems integrators, provide technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment, and bring the voice of the SLED customer back into Product, Sales, and Marketing.</p> <p><strong>Location and travel:</strong> The territory covers all states east of the Mississippi River. The candidate must reside in the Northeast part of the United States. This role requires up to 50% travel.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Engage SLED customers onsite and remotely, from state capitals to university campuses, with tailored demos, technical presentations, and hands-on workshops that tie GitLab to their mission.</li> <li>Partner with SLED account executives to shape account strategies that align with each customer's fiscal year budget cycle, legislative appropriations, IT modernization plans, and grant or federal pass through funding.</li> <li>Own the technical evaluation process, including proof of concept (POC) and proof of value (POV) design and delivery, and provide technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and security questionnaires.</li> <li>Support purchases made through cooperative purchasing agreements and statewide contract vehicles by working with channel and reseller partners.</li> <li>Guide customers through state and sector security requirements, such as GovRAMP and NIST frameworks, and show how GitLab's built in security, auditability, and deployment options reduce compliance burden.</li> <li>Help agencies and institutions modernize legacy and mainframe applications, such as unemployment insurance, tax, DMV, benefits, and student information systems, using GitLab and AI-assisted development to lower risk and offset shrinking pools of legacy skilled staff.</li> <li>Advise customers on adopting AI responsibly, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in line with state AI policies, governance boards, and data privacy requirements.</li> <li>Lead the creation of Customer Success Plans that capture technical success criteria and handoff details, ensuring a smooth path to deployment and adoption, often for IT teams with limited capacity.</li> <li>Work alongside Account Executives to build data driven business cases that quantify delivery bottlenecks, giving customers a defensible basis for budget requests and clear evidence of return on taxpayer investment.</li> <li>Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, agency directors, enterprise architects, faculty, research computing leaders, and procurement officers so they become advocates for GitLab, including across agencies and campuses that share services.</li> <li>Collaborate with systems integrators and state IT shared-services organizations to scale GitLab adoption across multiple agencies, local governments, or campuses.</li> <li>Serve as the SLED customer advocate internally, channeling feedback on procurement, compliance, and deployment needs to Product, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Stay current on GitLab and related technologies, and create reusable SLED demos, reference architectures, and assets for customers and partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Background in technical pre-sales, consulting, or IT roles serving state agencies, local governments, or public, private, and research universities, where you guided customers through evaluations and solution design.</li> <li>Working knowledge of how SLED organizations buy technology: RFP and RFI cycles, cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, fiscal-year budgeting, and the role of resellers and systems integrators.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using GitLab and familiarity with modern software development and operations practices, such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation.</li> <li>Experience with cloud, hybrid, and self-managed deployments in regulated environments, including government cloud regions, and an understanding of data residency and sovereignty concerns.</li> <li>Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks common in SLED, such as GovRAMP and NIST SP 800-53.</li> <li>Ability to connect technical solutions to mission outcomes, such as resident service delivery, cyber resilience, cost avoidance, and workforce efficiency, and to advise senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and options.</li> <li>Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including presenting to both technical teams and non-technical leaders such as agency heads, procurement officers, and university administrators.</li> <li>Openness to learning, seeking feedback, and building new skills, including familiarity with GitLab's Solutions Architect handbook and related resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience working in or for state or local government IT, or a university IT or research computing organization.</li> <li>Experience with legacy or mainframe modernization programs.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance practices in the public sector, such as AI use-case inventories, acceptable-use policies, and risk assessments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The SLED Solutions Architect role is part of GitLab's Public Sector Solutions Architect team, a group of trusted technical advisors who help government and education customers understand, evaluate, and adopt the GitLab DevSecOps platform. The team is distributed and collaborates asynchronously across time zones using GitLab and our handbook-first practices to share knowledge, reusable examples, and best practices.</p> <p>On the SLED team, you'll help customers solve challenges unique to state, local, and education organizations: protecting resident and student data, modernizing mission-critical legacy systems, buying through public procurement processes, and stretching limited IT staff and budgets. You'll also bring SLED customer insights back to GitLab to shape product direction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Lead Product Designer, Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London (Hybrid) / UK Remote | 💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐Our Design team</strong></p> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up over half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, engineering and data to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p><strong>We design for the "magic moments"</strong></p> <p>We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product <em>is</em> our personality. We blend research, empathy, data and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future — and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.</p> <p><strong>🌱 About Growth</strong></p> <p>Our Growth collective is focused on helping more people discover Monzo, understand what makes us different, and find the products that can make money work better for them.</p> <p>For this role, you’ll have a particular focus on our <strong>web experiences</strong>, helping us rethink how people discover, explore and choose Monzo before they ever open the app. You’ll combine strong visual and interaction design with a data-informed mindset, using experimentation and customer insight to understand what works and continuously improve the experience.</p> <p>You don’t need to have worked in a dedicated Growth team before. We’re interested in designers who are curious about customer behaviour, comfortable using data to inform their decisions, and excited by the opportunity to apply exceptional craft to high-impact customer journeys.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading the design of high-quality web experiences that help new and existing customers discover the value Monzo can bring to their financial lives.</li> <li>Using quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, understand customer behaviour and make informed design decisions.</li> <li>Turning customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, designing experiments and using what you learn to shape what we do next.</li> <li>Bringing exceptional visual and interaction craft to our web experiences, creating work that feels unmistakably Monzo while driving meaningful customer and commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Tackling complex and ambiguous design challenges, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to create simple, effective experiences.</li> <li>Defining compelling product visions and direction, helping teams think beyond individual experiments towards a coherent long-term customer experience.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Research throughout the design process, bringing people together around customer problems and opportunities.</li> <li>Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.</li> <li>Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of designing <strong>high-quality web experiences</strong>, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.</li> <li>You’re comfortable using <strong>data to inform your design decisions</strong>, partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.</li> <li>You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.</li> <li>You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.</li> <li>You can balance speed and description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <h1>About our Machine Learning Business Banking team</h1> <p>Our mission in Business Banking is to simplify banking for small businesses; making business banking fairer, simpler and more transparent. Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK’s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs.</p> <p>We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. We’re building intelligent, data-driven and AI/ML-enabled product experiences that help small businesses feel more in control, make better decisions, and get more value from Monzo.</p> <p>ML is at the core of how we build and scale our products, enabling Monzo to make better decisions, faster, and helping us serve businesses more effectively.</p> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist in Business Banking, you’ll help build and ship models that power the next generation of Business Banking experiences. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Analytics Engineering to bring ML-enabled product capability into the heart of how we build for businesses.</p> <p>Whether it’s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build intelligent product experiences responsibly, our work makes business banking smarter, simpler and more useful for SMEs.</p> <p> </p> <h1>What you'll be working on</h1> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.</p> <p>You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.</li> <li>Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.</li> <li>Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics.</li> <li>Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs.</li> <li>Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor.</li> <li>Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1>You should apply if</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company.</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact.</li> <li>You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity.</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day.</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions.</li> <li>You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain.</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas.</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability.</li> <li>You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use.</li> <li>You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.</li> <li>Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.</li> <li>Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.</li> <li>Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.</li> <li>Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you</h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Senior Field Marketer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline. As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners. - Drive pipeline goals in partnership with Sales by building field programs that create new opportunities and help advance existing ones. Track and report on pipeline contribution and program ROI. - Build out strategies, shape our calendar, and work closely with sales to build out a calendar that touches the evolving sales needs. - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition. - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs. - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 8+ years of related marketing experience. - You’re a leader. You take ownership, bring people together around a clear plan, and keep programs moving from idea through execution. You’re comfortable making decisions, navigating ambiguity, and building trust with partners along the way. - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life. - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics. - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it. - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses - Salesforce, Marketo experience We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $175,000-$200,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Stream Assessments to identify opportunities for customers to improve their software delivery, with support from a Senior SA.</p> <p>- Take part in conferences and trade shows, and contribute to case hypothesis and clear next steps toward production.</p> <p>- Technical experience: Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and containers, and working knowledge of on-premises, self-managed and restricted-network environments alongside cloud, including installation, configuration, upgrades and integration with existing enterprise tooling.</p> <p>- Experience supporting federal customers through technical evaluations, solution design and the path to authorization.</p> <p>- Experience with technical pre-sales, or as a professional in the field of information technology.</p> <p>- Experience with cloud computing platforms and related technologies in regulated or security conscious environments.Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks, such as FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, NIST 800-53 and the Risk Management Framework, DISA STIGs and FIPS 140, and how they shape deployment and tooling decisions.</p> <p>- The ability to connect technical solutions to measurable business or mission outcomes and to advise senior stakeholders on trade-offs and options.</p> <p>- Strong, confident communication and relationship building skills, including leading customer meetings, demos and value-focused conversations.</p> <p>- TS/SCI security clearance is a plus,  but not a requirement.</p> <p>- Location in the Washington, DC metro area.</p> <p>- Openness to learning, seeking feedback and building new skills.</p> <p>- Ability to travel at least 25%.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Public Sector Solutions Architecture team sits within GitLab Sales and works with U.S. federal and other government customers and partners to show how GitLab’s DevSecOps platform supports mission outcomes in regulated, security conscious environments.</p> <p>We work alongside the Public Sector sales team through every stage of the cycle, from first conversation and RFI or RFP responses to deployment and adoption.</p> <p>GitLab sells in a consumption-based model, so our work does not end at the proof of value. We stay close after the technical win to help agencies move from evaluation to production use and growth.</p> <p>We share what we learn, coach each other, and care about measurable mission outcomes.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. You will move beyond "assigned work" to actively improve the quality, reliability, and performance of our systems. You will work across product, frontend, infrastructure, data, and security boundaries, making sound architectural trade-offs, communicating complex ideas clearly in an asynchronous environment, and helping define the standards for a high-scale, global product.</p> <h2>Why you’ll love this role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>High Impact: </strong>You aren't just shipping features; you are shaping the architecture of a global platform used by millions.</li> <li><strong>Technical Agency: </strong>You will influence team objectives, technical direction, and long-range goals, helping us solve problems of high scope and complexity.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture: </strong>You will get to experiment with and integrate agentic AI into production engineering workflows, moving beyond simple prompt engineering to build resilient, AI-assisted systems.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy: </strong>You will thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration: </strong>You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, ensuring every technical decision delivers genuine value to our users.</li> </ul> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Technical Direction: </strong>Design and ship moderate to complex backend features with minimal guidance, making pragmatic choices between modular-monolith code, shared components, or independently operated services.</li> <li><strong>Raise the Bar: </strong>Advocate for product quality, security, availability, and performance. You will define backend standards for style, maintainability, testing, APIs, and operational readiness.</li> <li><strong>Mentor & Lead: </strong>Mentor associate and intermediate engineers, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices through code and design reviews.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence: </strong>Diagnose and prevent performance/reliability issues at scale. Participate in incident response and act as a technical owner where appropriate.</li> <li><strong>AI Integration: </strong>Use AI in production engineering work to improve outcomes, evaluate its effectiveness, and coach others on responsible, high-judgment use.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>On Call Support:</strong> Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deep Backend Expertise: </strong>A strong command of backend architecture, APIs, data systems, and performance tuning in a complex product or service environment.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability: </strong>Proficiency in modern backend languages and a deep understanding of systems programming. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.</p> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you'll set technical direction across teams while continuing to write and operate production software in Go. You'll lead work across the runner control plane, worker provisioning, and job execution. Your primary focus will be GitLab.com, and you'll also provide technical leadership support for GitLab Dedicated Hosted Runners. You'll report to the engineering manager responsible for Hosted Runners.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Some examples of our projects:</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Tuning autoscaling to reduce job wait times during demand spikes</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Evaluating ways to isolate customer workloads</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improving how runner usage is measured for capacity planning and billing</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Lead architecture and delivery across teams. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. You've personally shipped code that handles challenges such as concurrency, retries, or resource cleanup.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Strong programming skills in Go or another systems language, with the ability to become productive in Go.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Deep Linux and networking knowledge. You can trace production failures across system layers and use measurements to validate fixes.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience operating Kubernetes in production, including diagnosing scheduling and resource issues and managing rollouts and recovery.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience building or operating autoscaled or dynamically scheduled compute, such as VM fleets, serverless platforms, or batch systems. You bring experience with public cloud and infrastructure automation or comparable fleet operations.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A working understanding of the CI job lifecycle and the implications of running customer-controlled code. You can bring that knowledge from outside a CI/CD team.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A record of leading technical initiatives across teams and personally contributing to implementation through production. You build agreement through clear writing and asynchronous collaboration, and mentor engineers to own what they build and operate.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>About the team</strong></div> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">Hosted Runners operates the compute behind customers' CI/CD jobs. You'll work with Runner Core to turn lessons from operating the fleet into improvements to the open-source GitLab Runner. You'll also work with Product and partner teams to agree on priorities and ownership for shared changes.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Learn more:</strong></div> <ul class="ml-4 space-y-1"> <li><a class="text-[15px] font-medium" href="https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/dedicated/hosted_runners/" target="_blank">Hosted runners for GitLab Dedicated (docs)</a></li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: GTM Pricing & Packaging Lead, Commercial Operations
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. Your days may move from a Product discussion to a CRO presentation to a systems-focused meeting, turning GTM insight into investments EPD can act on. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Establish a coherent pricing and packaging perspective for Sales Assist that connects Self Serve pricing, customer value, and the needs of B2B and Enterprise customers. - By your 90th day: - Articulate the Sales Assist pricing-and-packaging narrative and the decisions it should guide. - Deliver a preliminary 18-month pricing and packaging roadmap, grounded in expected business impact and clear prioritization. - Use AI to monitor market trends, validate proposals, and surface business shifts that could change pricing and packaging decisions. - By the end of your first year: - Lead the GTM workstream for at least one pricing or packaging initiative, from recommendation through launch and impact assessment. - Establish a repeatable market-calibration and ROI feedback loop between GTM and EPD, raising the standard for how future investments are evaluated. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record of leading successful launches, starting with initial ideation, operationalization, and post launch analysis that allows us to tie bets with business outcomes. - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and commercial judgment—the role requires influencing Sales, Product, EPD, and senior leadership through complex decisions. - Ability to develop pricing recommendations using quantitative analysis, customer and seller research, market signals, and pricing experiments. - Curiosity and practical AI fluency: you use AI as a collaborator to analyze signals, test assumptions, validate proposals, and make the team’s work easier to build on. - Experience with B2B SaaS & AI Product Pricing, including Enterprise Offerings. - 12+ years experience with Pricing & Packaging. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. offering.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated success leading and developing technical support or engineering teams, including coaching, performance management, career development, and leadership through growth and change.</li> <li>A strong technical background supporting complex enterprise software or infrastructure, with the ability to assess operational, security, and regulatory constraints that shape their environments.
